sanguivorum.name: Sanguivorum
sanguivorum.title: The Empire of the Meadows
sanguivorum.blurb: Twelve cities, twelve Legions, five hundred seventy years of open-meadow order under Imperator Civis Alastair. “A citizen is a tool that knows itself.” Ingenum-engineered roads make Sanguivorum the easiest nation on the continent to cross — and the easiest to be watched in.

vaeloris.name: Vaeloris
vaeloris.title: The Ancient Forest & the Swamp Hegemony
vaeloris.blurb: Elf, lizardfolk, and dragonborn share an uneasy triarchy beneath the endless canopy, centered on the Arbor — the largest tree in existence. The forest paths are old and deliberately non-intuitive; the swamp beyond the Confluence answers to no one but the lizardfolk who guide it.

sahrimor.name: Sahrimor
sahrimor.title: The Desert Commercial Empire
sahrimor.blurb: Built around the lake Eternatum, which should not exist where it does. Ruled by the Merchant King through water, trade law, and sanctioned violence. Nine cities, a hundred caravans, and the Black Sands swallowing every expedition that goes looking for what's buried there.

thraekor.name: Thraekor
thraekor.title: The Ash Confederation
thraekor.blurb: Dwarven clanholds dug into a live volcanic range, built on the bones of a dwarf-dragonborn empire that burned five hundred seventy-two years ago. “What remains after everything burns” is not a metaphor here — it's the only principle that's held.

norrvael.name: Norrvael
norrvael.title: The Isle of Silence and Drakes
norrvael.blurb: An island hidden behind a Mist that doesn't behave like weather, ruled three hundred years by House Dravenkov. Something old sleeps under the mountains here, and the drakes have started listening for it.

kabal.name: The Golden Tear
kabal.title: Sovereign Territory of the Gods' Hand Kabal
kabal.blurb: A small neutral territory at the heart of the continent, bordered by Sanguivorum, Vaeloris, and Sahrimor, dominated by the thousand-foot obsidian Kabal Tower. No nation's law reaches here — only the Kabal's.

kabal_tower.name: Kabal Tower
kabal_tower.description: A thousand feet of obsidian rising from the fork of two rivers, exactly where they meet. The tower does not echo, does not cast a shadow the way it should, and is never fully silent. Somewhere beneath it, in a chamber called the Sepulcher, something with thirteen horns is not gone. Just waiting.

zuevaron.name: Zuevaron
zuevaron.title: The Heart of the Empire
zuevaron.description: Built where the great rivers converge beneath the shadow of the Kabal Bridge, Zuevaron is the political, military, and cultural capital of Sanguivorum. Every imperial road eventually leads here. Senators shape the future of the Empire, generals receive their commands, and citizens from every nation walk its streets.

imperialForum.name: The Imperial Forum
imperialForum.description: Zuevaron's civic core, where the machinery of governing an empire is visible at street level — petitioners waiting outside marble halls, couriers cutting between offices, citizens debating half-heard Senate business before it's even been voted on. Every imperial road empties into it eventually, whether you meant to arrive here or not.

imperatorsGate.name: The Imperator's Gate
imperatorsGate.description: The grand western entrance to the capital, where triumphal processions, ambassadors, and imperial guests first enter the city.

hallOfSenate.name: The Hall of the Senate
hallOfSenate.description: The seat of the Imperial Senate where the laws of Sanguivorum are debated and enacted.

palaceOfAscendus.name: The Palace of the Ascendus
palaceOfAscendus.description: Residence and administrative offices of the Imperator.

forumMagnus.name: The Forum Magnus
forumMagnus.description: The largest public square in the Empire. Political speeches, celebrations, executions, and festivals are all held here.

imperialLedger.name: The Imperial Ledger
imperialLedger.description: Official civic postings ranging from courier work to imperial contracts.

citizensQuarter.name: The Citizen's Quarter
citizensQuarter.description: Home to government officials, merchants, scholars, and long-established families.

officeOfCivicOrder.name: The Office of Civic Order
officeOfCivicOrder.description: The administrative headquarters of the Capital Watch.

imperialExchange.name: The Imperial Exchange
imperialExchange.description: The capital's commercial heart, where goods, currency, and rumor move faster than almost anywhere else in Sanguivorum. Every specialist shop here answers to the Mercantile Concord, but none of them pool their stock with it or with each other.

goldenScales.name: The Golden Scales
goldenScales.description: The largest general merchant in the Empire, stocking goods from every nation.

forgeImperialis.name: The Forge Imperialis
forgeImperialis.description: Master smiths forge ceremonial weapons beside equipment destined for the Imperial Legions.

gildedBulwark.name: The Gilded Bulwark
gildedBulwark.description: Renowned for producing armor for senators, officers, and the Imperial Guard.

imperialApothecary.name: The Imperial Apothecary
imperialApothecary.description: An enormous licensed alchemical house supplying everything from healing potions to rare reagents.

crownStables.name: The Crown Stables
crownStables.description: Maintains the finest horses available within Sanguivorum.

emperorsRest.name: The Emperor's Rest
emperorsRest.description: The capital's premier inn, hosting diplomats, nobles, and wealthy merchants.

mintExchange.name: The Mint Exchange
mintExchange.description: Converts currencies from across Fragmenta while safeguarding wealth for merchants and senators.

mercantileConcord.name: The Mercantile Concord
mercantileConcord.description: The governing body of commerce within the capital.

firstCitadel.name: The First Citadel
firstCitadel.description: The capital's own fortress-district, walled and garrisoned separately from the rest of Zuevaron even though it hasn't faced a siege in living memory. Legion columns drill here on a schedule as fixed as the Senate's own calendar.

imperialCitadel.name: The Imperial Citadel
imperialCitadel.description: Headquarters of the Imperial Legion and supreme military command of Sanguivorum.

hallOfVictories.name: The Hall of Victories
hallOfVictories.description: Campaign maps, captured standards, and the military history of the Empire fill this grand hall.

crimsonBarracks.name: The Crimson Barracks
crimsonBarracks.description: Housing for the elite Legion units assigned to protect the capital.

fieldOfEagles.name: The Field of Eagles
fieldOfEagles.description: The Empire's largest military training grounds.

imperialArsenal.name: The Imperial Arsenal
imperialArsenal.description: The most heavily guarded weapons repository in Sanguivorum.

engineersHall.name: The Engineers' Hall
engineersHall.description: Home of Ingenum's greatest military engineers.

quartermasterGeneral.name: The Quartermaster General
quartermasterGeneral.description: Coordinates supplies for every Legion throughout the Empire.

houseOfRecovery.name: The House of Recovery
houseOfRecovery.description: The finest military hospital in Sanguivorum.

crownOfTwelve.name: The Crown of the Twelve
crownOfTwelve.district: Religious Quarter (The Crown of the Twelve)
crownOfTwelve.description: Zuevaron's devotional quarter, built around the belief that a capital answering to every nation of the Empire should also answer to every god of the Pantheon. Incense, bells, and processions share the streets with off-duty clergy from a dozen different orders.

grandBasilicaOfAethyra.name: The Grand Basilica of Aethyra
grandBasilicaOfAethyra.district: Religious Quarter (The Crown of the Twelve)
grandBasilicaOfAethyra.description: The largest temple to Aethyra in Sanguivorum and one of the holiest sites outside the Kabal.

hallOfTwelve.name: The Hall of the Twelve
hallOfTwelve.district: Religious Quarter (The Crown of the Twelve)
hallOfTwelve.description: Magnificent shrines dedicated to every member of the Fragmenta pantheon.

pilgrimsHall.name: The Pilgrim's Hall
pilgrimsHall.district: Religious Quarter (The Crown of the Twelve)
pilgrimsHall.description: Hosts thousands of travelers and pilgrims each year.

gardenOfConcord.name: The Garden of Concord
gardenOfConcord.district: Religious Quarter (The Crown of the Twelve)
gardenOfConcord.description: A peaceful sanctuary dedicated to unity between the peoples of the Empire.

houseOfTwelveVoices.name: The House of Twelve Voices
houseOfTwelveVoices.district: Religious Quarter (The Crown of the Twelve)

sacredArchive.name: The Sacred Archive
sacredArchive.district: Religious Quarter (The Crown of the Twelve)
sacredArchive.description: Contains centuries of religious writings and temple records.

grandConclave.name: The Grand Conclave
grandConclave.description: The Kabal's largest presence outside the Tower itself, and the most closely watched quarter in the capital for it. Registered mages come and go under escort; unregistered ones don't come here at all if they know what's good for them.

grandConclaveHall.name: The Grand Conclave Hall
grandConclaveHall.description: The Kabal's principal administrative center outside the Tower itself.

registryOfRivers.name: The Registry of Rivers
registryOfRivers.description: Registers every legally recognized mage entering the capital.

hallOfConduits.name: The Hall of Conduits
hallOfConduits.description: Conducts magical evaluations and advanced conduit examinations.

imperialRepository.name: The Imperial Repository
imperialRepository.description: One of the greatest magical libraries on the continent.

magesResidence.name: The Mage's Residence
magesResidence.description: Housing for senior Kabal officials and visiting mages.

circleChamber.name: The Circle Chamber
circleChamber.description: Reserved for sanctioned long-distance magical transportation. The chamber stands ready; the network it's meant to connect to doesn't yet.

riverExchange.name: The River Exchange
riverExchange.description: Where the capital's river trade actually gets processed — less ceremony than the Imperial Exchange, more shouting, and considerably more mud. Every cargo bound anywhere in the Empire passes through here first.

riverGates.name: The River Gates
riverGates.description: Massive river checkpoints regulating traffic entering the capital.

customsHall.name: The Customs Hall
customsHall.description: Every shipment entering Zuevaron is documented here.

grandWarehouses.name: The Grand Warehouses
grandWarehouses.description: Gigantic storage halls supplying the Empire.

merchantDocks.name: The Merchant Docks
merchantDocks.description: Bustling river docks filled with vessels from every nation.

guildOfCaravans.name: The Guild of Caravans
guildOfCaravans.description: Coordinates the Empire's overland trade routes.

hallOfCommerce.name: The Hall of Commerce
hallOfCommerce.description: Economic policy for the Empire begins here.

foundryWard.name: The Foundry Ward
foundryWard.description: The capital's working quarter, where furnace-heat and stone dust replace the polish of the Imperial Forum. Every master craftsman in Sanguivorum wants a workshop here eventually, whether or not the Empire ever commissions them.

masterForge.name: The Master Forge
masterForge.description: Produces masterpieces for emperors and heroes alike.

marbleWorks.name: The Marble Works
marbleWorks.description: Responsible for many of the capital's monumental buildings.

weaversHall.name: The Weaver's Hall
weaversHall.description: Produces everything from Legion uniforms to senatorial robes.

hallOfGems.name: The Hall of Gems
hallOfGems.description: The Empire's finest jewelers and seal engravers.

inventorsCourt.name: The Inventor's Court
inventorsCourt.description: A gathering place for master craftsmen and engineers.

goldenHeights.name: The Golden Heights
goldenHeights.description: Terraced above the rest of the capital, close enough to smell the river and far enough not to hear it. Senators, generals, and foreign dignitaries all keep an address here, whether or not they ever sleep in it.

senatorialEstates.name: The Senatorial Estates
senatorialEstates.description: Residences of the Empire's most influential families.

embassyRow.name: The Embassy Row
embassyRow.description: Foreign embassies from every major nation.

imperialGardens.name: The Imperial Gardens
imperialGardens.description: Meticulously maintained gardens reserved for official ceremonies.

hallOfHonors.name: The Hall of Honors
hallOfHonors.description: Where imperial awards and noble titles are bestowed.

nobleClub.name: The Noble Club
nobleClub.description: A private gathering place for senators, generals, and wealthy patrons.

grandOvum.name: The Grand Ovum
grandOvum.description: The greatest arena in Fragmenta. Champions, beasts, tournaments, and imperial spectacles are held within its colossal walls.

kabalBridge.name: The Kabal Bridge
kabalBridge.description: The monumental bridge leading toward the Kabal Tower, symbolizing the alliance between imperial authority and magical oversight.

imperialPalace.name: The Imperial Palace
imperialPalace.description: The official residence of the Imperator and the symbolic heart of Sanguivorum.

eternalFlame.name: The Eternal Flame
eternalFlame.description: A perpetual flame honoring those who gave their lives in service to the Empire.

forgottenVaults.name: The Forgotten Vaults
forgottenVaults.description: Ancient storage chambers beneath the oldest districts of the capital.

undercity.name: The Undercity
undercity.description: A sprawling network of tunnels, forgotten foundations, and hidden passages beneath Zuevaron.

whisperMarket.name: The Whisper Market
whisperMarket.description: An unofficial night market where rare goods and whispered information change hands.

oldSenateRuins.name: The Old Senate Ruins
oldSenateRuins.description: The remnants of the senate hall that stood before the current imperial capital was expanded.

riverWalk.name: The River Walk
riverWalk.description: A scenic promenade along the riverbanks that often hosts festivals, entertainers, and traveling merchants.

watchCrown.name: The Watch Crown
watchCrown.description: The highest observation tower in Zuevaron, offering a view across the capital and surrounding countryside.

aphroneth.name: Aphroneth
aphroneth.title: The Jewel of the Western Sea
aphroneth.description: The premier commercial port of Sanguivorum, Aphroneth is the Empire's window to the world. Merchant fleets arrive daily carrying goods, cultures, and ideas from every nation. More foreign tongues are spoken here than anywhere else in Sanguivorum, and fortunes are won with a single successful voyage. As the Empire's most cosmopolitan city, Aphroneth balances imperial order with the constant rhythm of international commerce.

harborForum.name: The Harbor Forum
harborForum.description: The administrative heart of Aphroneth, where maritime law, commerce, and imperial governance intersect.

harborGate.name: The Harbor Gate
harborGate.description: The monumental entrance connecting the bustling docks to the city beyond. Nearly every foreign traveler begins their journey through Aphroneth here.

hallOfTideSenate.name: The Hall of the Tide Senate
hallOfTideSenate.description: The seat of the city's Ascendus senator. Trade law, harbor policy, and civic administration are directed from these chambers.

harborSquare.name: Harbor Square
harborSquare.description: The city's central plaza where merchants negotiate contracts, musicians entertain travelers, and public ceremonies celebrate successful expeditions.

marinersLedger.name: The Mariner's Ledger
marinersLedger.description: Requests for escorts, shipping contracts, monster hunts, courier work, and merchant commissions fill its notice boards daily.

sailorsWard.name: Sailor's Ward
sailorsWard.description: Home to generations of sailors, dockworkers, merchants, and fishing families whose livelihoods depend upon the harbor.

harborWatchHeadquarters.name: Harbor Watch Headquarters
harborWatchHeadquarters.description: The city's lawkeepers specialize in smuggling investigations, customs enforcement, and keeping order along the waterfront.

sapphireBazaar.name: The Sapphire Bazaar
sapphireBazaar.description: The wealthiest marketplace in eastern Sanguivorum, famous for imported goods rarely found elsewhere in the Empire.

tideMarket.name: The Tide Market
tideMarket.description: Carries everything from common travel supplies to exotic imports from every corner of Fragmenta.

ironAnchor.name: The Iron Anchor
ironAnchor.description: Produces dependable weapons alongside anchors, chains, harpoons, and heavy ship fittings designed to endure decades at sea.

seaBastionForge.name: The Sea Bastion Forge
seaBastionForge.description: Known for corrosion-resistant armor favored by marines, captains, and professional adventurers.

coralApothecary.name: The Coral Apothecary
coralApothecary.description: Specializes in healing tonics, antidotes, diving elixirs, and remedies derived from rare marine plants and creatures.

navigatorsRein.name: The Navigator's Rein
navigatorsRein.description: Maintains horses and pack animals for merchants continuing inland after arriving by sea.

bilgeAndBarrel.name: The Bilge & Barrel
bilgeAndBarrel.description: A legendary waterfront tavern where explorers, sailors, adventurers, and merchants exchange stories over strong drink.

harborExchange.name: The Harbor Exchange
harborExchange.description: Converts foreign currency, stores merchant wealth, and issues letters of credit recognized throughout the Empire.

merchantsConcord.name: The Merchant's Concord
merchantsConcord.description: Guild headquarters where trade disputes are settled and commercial ventures are negotiated.

seaBastion.name: The Sea Bastion
seaBastion.description: A heavily fortified district responsible for defending Sanguivorum's busiest harbor — the fortress overlooking Aphroneth's harbor entrance, coordinating all coastal defenses.

hallOfAdmirals.name: Hall of Admirals
hallOfAdmirals.description: Command center for the city's naval officers and harbor defense fleet.

marineBarracks.name: Marine Barracks
marineBarracks.description: Home to elite marines charged with defending the docks and escorting important vessels.

breakwaterGrounds.name: Breakwater Grounds
breakwaterGrounds.description: Training yards where marines practice boarding actions, shield formations, and coastal warfare.

navalArsenal.name: Naval Arsenal
navalArsenal.description: A secure armory storing weapons, armor, siege engines, and naval equipment.

signalTower.name: Signal Tower
signalTower.description: Beacon fires, signal flags, and mirrors coordinate ships approaching the harbor from leagues away.

quartermastersDock.name: Quartermaster's Dock
quartermastersDock.description: Supplies military vessels and oversees logistics for coastal patrols.

houseOfCalmWaters.name: House of Calm Waters
houseOfCalmWaters.description: Treats injured sailors, marines, and dockworkers returning from dangerous voyages.

sacredPrecinct.name: The Sacred Precinct
sacredPrecinct.description: The spiritual heart of Aphroneth, devoted to Seressa and her faith, the Heartward Communion, whose teachings of compassion, fellowship, and genuine human connection have made the city renowned for its hospitality. Candlelight and soft music carry from every open shrine door.

grandHeartwardShrine.name: The Grand Heartward Shrine
grandHeartwardShrine.description: The greatest Heartward Shrine in Sanguivorum. Weddings are celebrated beside the Fountain of Bonds while sailors departing on long voyages seek blessings for safe return and joyful reunion.

hallOfTwelve.name: Hall of the Twelve
hallOfTwelve.description: A circular sanctuary containing twelve equal chapels honoring every deity of Fragmenta.

pilgrimsRest.name: Pilgrim's Rest
pilgrimsRest.description: Welcomes pilgrims, travelers, and those with nowhere else to stay, regardless of wealth or homeland.

houseOfAmorites.name: House of the Amorites
houseOfAmorites.description: Residence of Aphroneth's clergy. The Amorites serve as counselors, matchmakers, wedding officiants, and mediators for broken relationships.

chamberOfReflection.name: Chamber of Reflection
chamberOfReflection.description: A quiet sanctuary where the heartbroken seek guidance and clarity beneath soft candlelight.

fountainOfBonds.name: Fountain of Bonds
fountainOfBonds.description: The most famous wedding site in the city, where countless vows have been exchanged beneath blooming roses.

hallOfDevotion.name: Hall of Devotion
hallOfDevotion.description: Filled with murals depicting legendary romances, acts of sacrifice, and lifelong friendships remembered by the Communion.

gardenSanctuary.name: Garden Sanctuary
gardenSanctuary.description: A peaceful garden representing both the beauty and unpredictability of love through carefully cultivated wild growth.

tideConclave.name: The Tide Conclave
tideConclave.description: The Kabal's maritime branch, overseeing navigation magic, magical weather observation, and arcane threats emerging from the sea.

tideConclaveHall.name: Tide Conclave Hall
tideConclaveHall.description: The official Kabal headquarters within Aphroneth.

registryOfNavigators.name: Registry of Navigators
registryOfNavigators.description: Registers licensed mages serving aboard merchant and naval vessels.

chamberOfCurrents.name: Chamber of Currents
chamberOfCurrents.description: Studies navigation magic, hydromancy, and weather manipulation.

oceanicRepository.name: Oceanic Repository
oceanicRepository.description: Archives magical research concerning sea monsters, storms, ocean currents, and maritime expeditions.

magesAnchorage.name: Mage's Anchorage
magesAnchorage.description: Housing for Conclave personnel stationed in Aphroneth.

beaconCircle.name: Beacon Circle
beaconCircle.description: Reserved for sanctioned magical transportation. Like the Circle Chamber at Zuevaron, it stands ready for a network that doesn't yet exist.

grandDocks.name: The Grand Docks
grandDocks.description: The busiest harbor in Sanguivorum and among the largest commercial ports on the continent.

harborGates.name: Harbor Gates
harborGates.description: Primary arrival point for vessels entering Aphroneth.

customsHall.name: Customs Hall
customsHall.description: Every cargo entering the Empire is inspected, documented, and taxed here.

longWharves.name: Long Wharves
longWharves.description: Miles of stone docks capable of servicing merchant fleets from every nation.

merchantWarehouses.name: Merchant Warehouses
merchantWarehouses.description: Secure storage halls protecting valuable imports awaiting distribution.

harborMastersOffice.name: Harbor Master's Office
harborMastersOffice.description: Directs harbor traffic, docking assignments, and maritime safety.

fishermansLanding.name: Fisherman's Landing
fishermansLanding.description: Home to Aphroneth's fishing fleet and the city's bustling morning fish market.

shipwrightsWard.name: The Shipwright's Ward
shipwrightsWard.description: The industrial district where vessels destined to cross the seas are designed, built, and repaired.

ironKeel.name: Iron Keel
ironKeel.description: Produces anchors, chains, reinforced hull fittings, and heavy naval hardware.

sailmakersLoft.name: Sailmaker's Loft
sailmakersLoft.description: Crafts sails, banners, expedition tents, and maritime canvas.

brassSextant.name: Brass Sextant
brassSextant.description: Offers navigation instruments, maps, compasses, and surveying equipment.

ropewalk.name: Ropewalk
ropewalk.description: Produces rope, rigging, and heavy cable for fleets across the Empire.

drydockWorks.name: Drydock Works
drydockWorks.description: Constructs and repairs everything from fishing boats to imperial warships.

carpentersWharf.name: Carpenter's Wharf
carpentersWharf.description: Builds masts, docks, wagons, and structural timbers for maritime construction.

pearlHeights.name: The Pearl Heights
pearlHeights.description: Perched above the harbor, this district houses Aphroneth's wealthiest merchant dynasties and foreign dignitaries.

houseOfHarborLord.name: House of the Harbor Lord
houseOfHarborLord.description: Residence of the city's Ascendus senator.

merchantEstates.name: Merchant Estates
merchantEstates.description: Elegant villas belonging to Aphroneth's influential merchant families.

embassyRow.name: Embassy Row
embassyRow.description: Diplomatic residences representing nations across Fragmenta.

pearlGardens.name: Pearl Gardens
pearlGardens.description: Terraced gardens overlooking the sea, often used for formal receptions and diplomatic negotiations.

hallOfMaritimeHonors.name: Hall of Maritime Honors
hallOfMaritimeHonors.description: Recognizes extraordinary achievements in commerce, exploration, and naval service.

captainsClub.name: Captain's Club
captainsClub.description: An exclusive gathering place for admirals, renowned captains, and merchant princes.

lighthouseOfAphroneth.name: Lighthouse of Aphroneth
lighthouseOfAphroneth.description: A towering beacon guiding ships safely into the Empire's greatest harbor.

seaKingsArch.name: Sea King's Arch
seaKingsArch.description: A monumental stone arch spanning the inner harbor, symbolizing Sanguivorum's prosperity through trade.

harborBell.name: Harbor Bell
harborBell.description: A colossal bronze bell announcing fleet arrivals, emergencies, and imperial proclamations.

promenadeOfSails.name: Promenade of Sails
promenadeOfSails.description: A lively waterfront lined with markets, performers, restaurants, and merchant stalls overlooking the sea.

saltTunnels.name: Salt Tunnels
saltTunnels.description: Ancient tunnels beneath the docks once used by smugglers and now inhabited by far more dangerous things.

whisperDocks.name: Whisper Docks
whisperDocks.description: An abandoned section of harbor where illicit trade flourishes after sunset.

tidePools.name: Tide Pools
tidePools.description: Rocky coves rich in rare marine life and valuable alchemical ingredients.

forgottenBreakwater.name: Forgotten Breakwater
forgottenBreakwater.description: The crumbling remains of Aphroneth's original harbor defenses.

deepAnchorage.name: Deep Anchorage
deepAnchorage.description: A secluded harbor where expeditions into dangerous or unknown waters are organized.

gullsWatch.name: Gull's Watch
gullsWatch.description: A cliffside overlook offering breathtaking views of Aphroneth, the harbor, and the endless western sea.

arethon.name: Arethon
arethon.title: The Eastern Bastion
arethon.description: A former commercial gateway transformed by war into Sanguivorum's principal eastern fortress. Arethon still carries the bones of a trade city, but nearly every street now serves the frontier: soldiers drill beside caravan yards, merchants bargain beneath watchtowers, and memorials stand where warehouses once did.

connections.desc: the bridge road, through the Desert War front

forum.name: The Forum
forum.description: Arethon's civic heart, where the business of actually running a fortress city gets done — petitions, measures, notices, and the watch that keeps it all from fraying at the edges. The roads through here are cut wide enough for a Legion column, on the rare day one needs to pass through the Forum rather than around it.

aretineGate.name: The Aretine Gate
aretineGate.description: Arethon's primary western entrance and the roadward face of the city. Travelers entering from the Sanguivorum interior pass beneath bronze reliefs depicting the city before and after its militarization.

hallOfAscendus.name: The Hall of the Ascendus
hallOfAscendus.description: The administrative seat of Arethon's ruling senator. Petitions, legal disputes, taxation matters, and official appointments are handled within its severe marble chambers.

chamberOfMeasures.name: The Chamber of Measures
chamberOfMeasures.description: A smaller civic hall where city officials record supply levels, population movement, commercial output, and military readiness. Arethon measures itself constantly.

squareOfFirstStandard.name: The Square of the First Standard
squareOfFirstStandard.description: The central public plaza, named for the first Legion standard raised when Arethon became a fortress city. Public announcements, civic ceremonies, and military departures begin here.

bronzeLedger.name: The Bronze Ledger
bronzeLedger.description: Arethon's public notice board, framed in bronze and guarded against tampering. Jobs, decrees, missing-person notices, military requisitions, and public judgments are posted here.

citizensSteps.name: The Citizens' Steps
citizensSteps.description: A broad residential ward built along rising stone terraces. Veterans, civic officials, artisans, and long-established families occupy the tightly ordered streets.

vigilOffice.name: The Vigil Office
vigilOffice.description: Headquarters of the city watch. Less prestigious than the Legion, but far more involved in theft, unrest, smuggling, and ordinary city crime.

marchesMarket.name: The Marches Market
marchesMarket.description: Arethon's trading heart, still busy in the old commercial-gateway way even with half the city rebuilt around a garrison. Five specialist shops ring the square, each keeping its own stock rather than pooling it with the rest.

frontierProvisioner.name: The Frontier Provisioner
frontierProvisioner.description: A general merchant specializing in travel goods, preserved food, rope, waterskins, lanterns, and basic adventuring supplies. Its stock reflects Arethon's position between meadow and desert.

legionsArms.name: The Legion's Arms
legionsArms.description: A respected blacksmith whose weapons are made to Legion measurements even when sold to civilians. Plain, durable, and rarely decorative.

redShield.name: The Red Shield
redShield.description: Arethon's principal armorer. The shop is known for reinforced shields, layered frontier armor, and repairs performed quickly enough for soldiers returning to duty.

potionarium.name: The Potionarium
potionarium.description: A licensed alchemical dispensary marked by blue-glass windows and the sharp smell of medicinal herbs. It sells healing draughts, tonics, antitoxins, and approved battlefield mixtures.

goldenRein.name: The Golden Rein
goldenRein.description: A stable and animal yard serving couriers, caravan masters, officers, and travelers. Sanguivorum horses occupy the front stalls; desert mounts and pack animals are kept farther back.

marchingMug.name: The Marching Mug
marchingMug.description: A broad, noisy inn favored by soldiers, caravan guards, and low-ranking officers. The walls are covered in retired shields, old route maps, and names carved by departing Legionnaires.

easternScale.name: The Eastern Scale
easternScale.description: The licensed money changer and appraisal house. Foreign coin, trade bars, gemstones, and sealed merchant credit are converted under civic supervision.

concordOffice.name: The Concord Office
concordOffice.description: The local merchant association hall. Trade disputes, caravan partnerships, shipping claims, and commercial licenses are negotiated here.

easternCitadel.name: The Eastern Citadel
easternCitadel.description: The fortress-within-the-fortress, walled off even from the rest of Arethon. Everything here runs on Legion time and Legion authorization — checkpoints at every approach, and no one wanders in by accident.

bastionOfEasternWatch.name: The Bastion of the Eastern Watch
bastionOfEasternWatch.description: Arethon's defining structure and the headquarters of its Legion command. It overlooks the border approaches and dominates the skyline with layered walls, signal towers, and artillery platforms.

hallOfStandards.name: The Hall of Standards
hallOfStandards.description: The formal Legion headquarters within the citadel. Unit standards, campaign records, casualty rolls, and commendations are preserved beneath guarded arches.

stoneCohorts.name: The Stone Cohorts
stoneCohorts.description: The principal barracks complex. Its long buildings house rotating Legion units, frontier scouts, engineers, and reserve formations.

fieldOfIron.name: The Field of Iron
fieldOfIron.description: Arethon's primary training ground. Soldiers drill in formation, test weapons, conduct mock breaches, and train for desert and river combat.

redArsenal.name: The Red Arsenal
redArsenal.description: The secured weapon and armor storehouse supplying the city's garrison. Civilian access is forbidden without military authorization.

enginesYard.name: The Engines' Yard
enginesYard.description: A fortified open yard filled with ballistae, mobile towers, rams, and siege mechanisms. Ingenum engineers constantly test and modify equipment here.

quartermastersLedger.name: The Quartermaster's Ledger
quartermastersLedger.description: The distribution office for military equipment, rations, uniforms, and replacement gear. Nothing leaves without a signature, seal, and recorded destination.

houseOfReturning.name: The House of Returning
houseOfReturning.description: Arethon's military hospital. Wounded soldiers arrive here directly from the gates, docks, and frontier posts.

officersColonnade.name: The Officers' Colonnade
officersColonnade.description: A restrained assembly hall where commanders meet, dine, plan operations, and receive official visitors.

sacredPrecinct.name: The Sacred Precinct
sacredPrecinct.description: Arethon's devotional heart, quieter than the rest of the city even at midday. Incense and old stone rather than oiled leather and orders — the one quarter where the war doesn't quite reach.

grandBasilica.name: The Grand Basilica of Kar'Mhal
grandBasilica.description: Arethon's principal temple and the spiritual heart of the city. Legionnaires seek courage before battle, commanders offer trophies after victory, and families pray for those posted beyond the walls.

hallOfTwelve.name: The Hall of the Twelve
hallOfTwelve.description: A circular sanctuary containing twelve equal chapels, one for each deity of Fragmenta. Kar'Mhal's chapel is the most heavily attended, but none are treated as lesser.

houseOfFirstStep.name: The House of the First Step
houseOfFirstStep.description: Aethyra's local pilgrim house. Travelers, messengers, caravan guards, and soldiers departing on long campaigns receive route blessings here.

gardenOfFinalHonor.name: The Garden of Final Honor
gardenOfFinalHonor.description: A quiet memorial garden jointly tended by the clergy of Kar'Mhal and Mortasha. The dead are remembered not only for how they died, but for what their lives accomplished.

wallOfEasternWatch.name: The Wall of the Eastern Watch
wallOfEasternWatch.description: A long black-stone memorial engraved with the names of those who died defending Arethon and the eastern frontier.

pilgrimsMeasure.name: The Pilgrim's Measure
pilgrimsMeasure.description: A modest hostel for religious travelers, military families, and those visiting the memorials. Payment is accepted, but no pilgrim is turned away for lacking coin.

houseOfTwelveVoices.name: The House of Twelve Voices
houseOfTwelveVoices.description: The residence and meeting place of Arethon's clergy. Priests debate doctrine, coordinate festivals, and organize charitable work from here.

sacredRecord.name: The Sacred Record
sacredRecord.description: A temple archive containing burial rolls, campaign blessings, oaths, marriages, pilgrim accounts, and records of religious service.

theConclave.name: The Conclave
theConclave.description: Arethon's smallest quarter and its most watched. Kabal robes move differently through a crowd than anyone else's — not hurried, never quite idle either — and every door here has a reason to be locked.

conclaveHallOfArethon.name: The Conclave Hall of Arethon
conclaveHallOfArethon.description: The official Kabal presence in the city. Registered mages, civic authorities, and Legion officers meet here when magical matters affect the frontier.

registryOfConduits.name: The Registry of Conduits
registryOfConduits.description: The office responsible for recording mages, conduits, magical affiliations, and authorized practice. Its records are precise and closely guarded.

chamberOfRecognition.name: The Chamber of Recognition
chamberOfRecognition.description: A controlled examination room used to identify magical aptitude and assess unstable or newly awakened practitioners.

easternRepository.name: The Eastern Repository
easternRepository.description: A compact arcane archive containing regional magical reports, approved texts, creature records, and classified frontier observations.

veiledDormitory.name: The Veiled Dormitory
veiledDormitory.description: Housing for Conclave personnel, visiting mages, apprentices, and Kabal functionaries posted temporarily to Arethon.

sealedCourt.name: The Sealed Court
sealedCourt.description: A secure chamber for dangerous artifacts, confiscated magical objects, and evidence awaiting transfer to the Kabal Tower.

caravanExchange.name: The Caravan Exchange
caravanExchange.description: The working end of Arethon's commerce — less browsing, more paperwork. Wagon wheels and ledger stamps instead of the Marches Market's haggling, and everyone here has somewhere to be.

gateOfWeights.name: The Gate of Weights
gateOfWeights.description: The controlled eastern entrance used by caravans arriving from Sahrimor. Every wagon, seal, manifest, and water allotment is inspected here.

officeOfSeals.name: The Office of Seals
officeOfSeals.description: Arethon's customs house. Trade permissions, caravan licenses, tariffs, and border documentation are issued and reviewed within.

nineRoadsYard.name: The Nine Roads Yard
nineRoadsYard.description: A sprawling caravan staging ground divided by route, destination, and cargo type. The name refers to the old belief that every road worth traveling eventually passed through Arethon.

longWarehouse.name: The Long Warehouse
longWarehouse.description: The largest bonded warehouse in the city. Foreign goods remain here until inspected, taxed, released, or confiscated.

easternFreightHall.name: The Eastern Freight Hall
easternFreightHall.description: A commercial dispatch office connecting merchants with wagons, guards, couriers, pack animals, and river transport.

riverTeeth.name: The River Teeth
riverTeeth.description: Arethon's fortified docks, named for the angled stone piers that break the current. Military ferries, merchant barges, and patrol boats share the riverfront.

caravanMastersHouse.name: The Caravan Masters' House
caravanMastersHouse.description: A private but influential meeting hall used by major trade companies, route planners, and licensed convoy leaders.

dustCourt.name: The Dust Court
dustCourt.description: An open inspection yard for desert caravans. Sand is swept from cargo, animals are checked, and suspicious shipments are isolated before entering the city.

artisansWard.name: The Artisan's Ward
artisansWard.description: The hammer-and-forge counterpart to the Marches Market — less about buying and selling, more about the things Arethon actually needs made or fixed. The air smells like sawdust, hot iron, and tanned hide in roughly equal measure.

timberLine.name: The Timber Line
timberLine.description: A carpentry and wagonmaking district producing carts, siege frames, storage chests, scaffolding, and military transport equipment.

whiteHammer.name: The White Hammer
whiteHammer.description: A masonry workshop known for frontier fortification work, reinforced foundations, and rapid wall repair.

hideAndRivet.name: The Hide and Rivet
hideAndRivet.description: A leatherworker supplying harnesses, boots, straps, armor backing, saddles, and shield grips.

crimsonThread.name: The Crimson Thread
crimsonThread.description: A tailor serving both soldiers and civilians. It produces uniforms, officer cloaks, travel clothes, and formal civic dress.

twelveFacets.name: The Twelve Facets
twelveFacets.description: A jeweler and seal-cutter specializing in signet rings, military honors, temple offerings, and merchant marks.

makersCourt.name: The Makers' Court
makersCourt.description: A shared workshop complex where smaller craftspeople rent space, tools, and furnace time.

brokenWheel.name: The Broken Wheel
brokenWheel.description: A repair yard infamous for never closing. Wagons damaged on the frontier often arrive here before their owners find lodging.

highWard.name: The High Ward
highWard.district: Noble and Diplomatic Quarter (The High Ward)
highWard.description: Arethon's quietest streets, in the specific way that comes from everyone in them being careful. Wide avenues, high walls, and the sense that every conversation here is also, somehow, a negotiation.

houseOfEasternSeat.name: The House of the Eastern Seat
houseOfEasternSeat.district: Noble and Diplomatic Quarter (The High Ward)
houseOfEasternSeat.description: The official residence of Arethon's Ascendus senator. Less a palace than a fortified administrative estate.

laurelTerraces.name: The Laurel Terraces
laurelTerraces.district: Noble and Diplomatic Quarter (The High Ward)
laurelTerraces.description: A collection of villas occupied by senior officers, wealthy merchants, established civic families, and retired senators.

houseOfSandAndBronze.name: The House of Sand and Bronze
houseOfSandAndBronze.district: Noble and Diplomatic Quarter (The High Ward)
houseOfSandAndBronze.description: The formal residence assigned to Sahrimori envoys and trade representatives. Its guards are watched nearly as closely as its guests.

quietEmbassy.name: The Quiet Embassy
quietEmbassy.district: Noble and Diplomatic Quarter (The High Ward)
quietEmbassy.description: A neutral residence used by delegations from nations other than Sahrimor. Its name reflects the expectation that foreign visitors speak carefully in Arethon.

governorsGarden.name: The Governor's Garden
governorsGarden.district: Noble and Diplomatic Quarter (The High Ward)
governorsGarden.description: A walled ceremonial garden used for private meetings, honors, negotiations, and carefully staged public receptions.

hallOfProvenMerit.name: The Hall of Proven Merit
hallOfProvenMerit.district: Noble and Diplomatic Quarter (The High Ward)
hallOfProvenMerit.description: A banquet and civic reception hall where promotions, awards, military appointments, and commercial recognitions are announced.

easternWall.name: The Eastern Wall
easternWall.description: The immense defensive barrier facing the frontier. Its towers are never unmanned, and its signal fires can summon the garrison before the city bells begin.

veteransSquare.name: Veterans' Square
veteransSquare.description: A memorial plaza surrounded by statues of soldiers, engineers, healers, scouts, and civilians who preserved the city during past crises.

oldBridgeArch.name: The Old Bridge Arch
oldBridgeArch.description: The surviving stone arch from Arethon's earlier life as a trade hub. The original bridge is gone, but the arch remains as a reminder that commerce existed before the fortress.

oldTradeRoad.name: The Old Trade Road
oldTradeRoad.description: A partially abandoned street from Arethon's mercantile era. Closed shops, neglected courtyards, and forgotten storage cellars make it useful to smugglers and quest-givers.

theUnderflow.name: The Underflow
theUnderflow.description: Arethon's sewer and drainage system. Old brick channels intersect with newer military tunnels, and not every passage appears on civic maps.

shrineWithoutName.name: The Shrine Without a Name
shrineWithoutName.description: A small pre-imperial shrine buried beneath later construction. Its original deity and purpose have been forgotten.

fieldOfEmptyHelms.name: The Field of Empty Helms
fieldOfEmptyHelms.description: Arethon's eastern cemetery, named for the helmets placed atop the graves of soldiers whose bodies were never recovered.

hollowMile.name: The Hollow Mile
hollowMile.description: A suspected smuggling passage connecting old warehouses to the riverbank. City officials deny that it exists.

lastWatch.name: The Last Watch
lastWatch.description: A distant wall tower used for solitary observation, disciplinary postings, and sightings too uncertain to place in official reports.

fallenGranary.name: The Fallen Granary
fallenGranary.description: An abandoned warehouse damaged during an old siege. Parts of the interior remain unstable and officially closed.

redbank.name: The Redbank
redbank.description: A stretch of river outside the fortified docks where fishermen, scavengers, ferrymen, and illicit traders gather.

walkOfStandards.name: The Walk of Standards
walkOfStandards.description: A patrol route along the upper city walls. Retired campaign standards are displayed at intervals beneath protective stone canopies.

apollyon.name: Apollyon
apollyon.title: The Eternal Archive
apollyon.description: While other cities preserve the Empire through steel or commerce, Apollyon preserves it through memory. Home to the renowned Guild Historia, the city safeguards the written history of Sanguivorum and countless civilizations that came before it. Historians, archaeologists, scribes, cartographers, librarians, and relic hunters all pass through its gates. Here, every artifact has a story, every ruin has a record, and every life is worthy of remembrance.

connections.desc: a half-day into the flooded ruins outside the city

archivistsForum.name: The Archivist's Forum
archivistsForum.description: The administrative center where history itself is protected by law.

chronicleGate.name: The Chronicle Gate
chronicleGate.description: The principal entrance to Apollyon, adorned with statues depicting the great ages of Fragmenta.

hallOfRecords.name: Hall of Records
hallOfRecords.description: Seat of Apollyon's Ascendus senator and administrative headquarters for the city's civic archives.

chronicleSquare.name: Chronicle Square
chronicleSquare.description: A quiet public plaza where historians unveil discoveries, scholars lecture, and civic ceremonies commemorate the past.

historiansLedger.name: The Historian's Ledger
historiansLedger.description: Expeditions, archaeological contracts, relic recoveries, research commissions, and historical investigations are posted here.

scholarsQuarter.name: Scholar's Quarter
scholarsQuarter.description: Home to scribes, professors, archivists, and generations of historians.

civicRegistry.name: Civic Registry
civicRegistry.description: Maintains birth records, census rolls, property deeds, and official imperial documents.

antiquarianMarket.name: Antiquarian Market
antiquarianMarket.description: Every merchant specializes in preserving, restoring, or discovering history.

theAntiquary.name: The Antiquary
theAntiquary.description: Stocks expedition gear, journals, inks, parchment, surveying tools, and scholarly supplies.

relicForge.name: Relic Forge
relicForge.description: Produces precision excavation tools, restoration implements, ceremonial weapons, and replica artifacts.

curatorsArmory.name: Curator's Armory
curatorsArmory.description: Crafts equipment designed for archaeologists, explorers, and relic hunters venturing into ancient ruins.

preservationLaboratory.name: Preservation Laboratory
preservationLaboratory.description: Produces preservation oils, restoration chemicals, inks, adhesives, and alchemical compounds for artifact conservation.

expeditionStables.name: Expedition Stables
expeditionStables.description: Maintains mounts used by archaeological expeditions and scholarly caravans.

dustAndQuill.name: The Dust & Quill
dustAndQuill.description: A favorite gathering place for explorers returning with discoveries from across Fragmenta.

imperialDepository.name: Imperial Depository
imperialDepository.description: Provides secure vaults for wealthy collectors, museums, and expedition funding.

guildExchange.name: Guild Exchange
guildExchange.description: Coordinates research expeditions and artifact acquisitions throughout the continent.

archiveBastion.name: The Archive Bastion
archiveBastion.description: Knowledge must be defended as fiercely as any fortress — the fortress protecting Guild Historia and the city's irreplaceable collections.

hallOfCustodians.name: Hall of Custodians
hallOfCustodians.description: Headquarters of the elite guardians assigned to protect Apollyon's archives.

custodianBarracks.name: Custodian Barracks
custodianBarracks.description: Housing for soldiers specially trained in artifact protection and archive defense.

preservationGrounds.name: Preservation Grounds
preservationGrounds.description: Custodians train in urban defense, artifact recovery, and protection of irreplaceable relics.

archiveArsenal.name: Archive Arsenal
archiveArsenal.description: Stores weapons and equipment dedicated to defending the city's priceless collections.

houseOfRestoration.name: House of Restoration
houseOfRestoration.description: Treats explorers, soldiers, and scholars injured during expeditions.

sentinelArchiveTower.name: Sentinel Archive Tower
sentinelArchiveTower.description: An observation tower overlooking both the city and the surrounding ruins.

sacredPrecinct.name: The Sacred Precinct
sacredPrecinct.description: The faithful of Mortasha believe that death is not oblivion, but remembrance. Every life leaves behind a story, and preserving those stories is among the highest forms of devotion.

grandTempleOfMortasha.name: The Grand Temple of Mortasha
grandTempleOfMortasha.description: The greatest sanctuary dedicated to Mortasha in Sanguivorum. Families preserve ancestral records here, while historians honor those whose lives shaped the Empire.

hallOfTwelve.name: Hall of the Twelve
hallOfTwelve.description: Contains twelve shrines honoring every deity of Fragmenta.

pilgrimsRest.name: Pilgrim's Rest
pilgrimsRest.description: Welcomes pilgrims, mourners, scholars, and travelers.

houseOfFaithful.name: House of the Faithful
houseOfFaithful.description: Residence of Apollyon's clergy and caretakers of sacred memorials.

gardenOfRemembrance.name: Garden of Remembrance
gardenOfRemembrance.description: A tranquil sanctuary where engraved stones preserve the names of generations long passed.

sacredArchives.name: Sacred Archives
sacredArchives.description: Maintains sacred texts, genealogies, funeral records, and centuries of ecclesiastical history.

guildHistoria.name: Guild Historia
guildHistoria.description: The greatest historical institution in Fragmenta, dedicated to preserving knowledge before it is lost forever — the most comprehensive historical institution in Fragmenta, preserving the collective memory of civilizations across the continent.

grandHallOfHistoria.name: Grand Hall of Historia
grandHallOfHistoria.description: The central headquarters of Guild Historia and the largest historical archive in the Empire.

registryOfExpeditions.name: Registry of Expeditions
registryOfExpeditions.description: Coordinates archaeological expeditions, relic recovery teams, and historical surveys.

chamberOfRestoration.name: Chamber of Restoration
chamberOfRestoration.description: Studies magical preservation, artifact restoration, and ancient enchantments.

theGrandRepository.name: The Grand Repository
theGrandRepository.description: An immense library containing historical records, maps, journals, recovered relics, and ancient manuscripts.

scholarsResidence.name: Scholar's Residence
scholarsResidence.description: Housing for historians, librarians, archaeologists, and visiting researchers.

archiveCircle.name: Archive Circle
archiveCircle.description: Reserved for sanctioned magical transportation of priceless historical materials.

expeditionQuarter.name: The Expedition Quarter
expeditionQuarter.description: The logistical center supporting historical expeditions throughout Fragmenta.

explorersGate.name: Explorer's Gate
explorersGate.description: The departure point for archaeological caravans and scholarly expeditions.

imperialCustoms.name: Imperial Customs
imperialCustoms.description: Records relics and recovered artifacts entering the city.

preservationVaults.name: Preservation Vaults
preservationVaults.description: Climate-controlled storage for newly recovered historical treasures.

expeditionHall.name: Expedition Hall
expeditionHall.description: Organizes exploration teams, supply caravans, and research missions.

surveyorsOffice.name: Surveyor's Office
surveyorsOffice.description: Maintains official maps and records of newly explored regions.

caravanDepot.name: Caravan Depot
caravanDepot.description: Supplies expeditions before they depart into the unknown.

restorationWard.name: Restoration Ward
restorationWard.description: Master craftsmen dedicated to preserving the past.

legacyForge.name: Legacy Forge
legacyForge.description: Restores ceremonial weapons and reproduces historical arms using traditional techniques.

stoneConservatory.name: Stone Conservatory
stoneConservatory.description: Repairs monuments, ruins, and historical architecture.

archivistTailors.name: Archivist Tailors
archivistTailors.description: Produces archival cloth, protective wrappings, and expedition garments.

relicJewelers.name: Relic Jewelers
relicJewelers.description: Restores crowns, jewelry, seals, and precious artifacts recovered from ancient civilizations.

conservatorsWorkshop.name: Conservator's Workshop
conservatorsWorkshop.description: A collaborative workshop where damaged relics are restored for study and display.

scribesWorkshop.name: Scribe's Workshop
scribesWorkshop.description: Produces parchment, inks, maps, journals, illuminated manuscripts, and calligraphy supplies.

scholarsHeights.name: Scholar's Heights
scholarsHeights.description: Home to Guild Historia's senior scholars and Apollyon's civic leaders.

historiansEstates.name: Historian's Estates
historiansEstates.description: Homes of renowned scholars, collectors, and Guild Historia masters.

embassyHall.name: Embassy Hall
embassyHall.description: Hosts foreign scholars and diplomatic representatives seeking access to the archives.

memorialGardens.name: Memorial Gardens
memorialGardens.description: A peaceful garden where monuments commemorate the greatest historians and explorers of Fragmenta.

hallOfLegacy.name: Hall of Legacy
hallOfLegacy.description: Recognizes extraordinary contributions to scholarship, preservation, and historical discovery.

archivistsCircle.name: The Archivist's Circle
archivistsCircle.description: A private gathering place where historians, archaeologists, and philosophers debate the mysteries of the past.

grandArchive.name: The Grand Archive
grandArchive.description: A colossal library containing millions of scrolls, codices, maps, and records spanning thousands of years.

hallOfAges.name: The Hall of Ages
hallOfAges.description: A museum displaying the Empire's most significant relics, artifacts, and archaeological discoveries.

memoryObelisk.name: The Memory Obelisk
memoryObelisk.description: A towering monument engraved with the names of individuals whose contributions forever changed Fragmenta.

sealedVaults.name: The Sealed Vaults
sealedVaults.description: Ancient subterranean repositories containing relics too dangerous or mysterious for public study.

forgottenCatacombs.name: The Forgotten Catacombs
forgottenCatacombs.description: Burial chambers beneath the city holding generations of history — and secrets never meant to be rediscovered.

excavationFields.name: The Excavation Fields
excavationFields.description: An active archaeological site where new discoveries are made throughout the year.

lostRepository.name: The Lost Repository
lostRepository.description: The ruins of an archive that predates the founding of Sanguivorum, its surviving records written in forgotten tongues.

explorersEncampment.name: Explorer's Encampment
explorersEncampment.description: The departure point for expeditions into ancient ruins, lost temples, and forgotten civilizations.

scholarsOverlook.name: The Scholar's Overlook
scholarsOverlook.description: A quiet terrace overlooking Apollyon, where historians gather to reflect on the enduring legacy of the Empire and the countless stories still waiting to be uncovered.

sunken_archive.name: The Sunken Archive
sunken_archive.description: A wing of the Guild Historia's own archive that flooded and collapsed long before Apollyon's current walls went up — sealed by the Guild, rediscovered by someone who didn't ask permission, sealed again. Whatever's down there now has had a very long time to make itself at home.

tritonath.name: Tritonath
tritonath.title: The Gate of the Western Fjords
tritonath.description: Built around an ancient lighthouse that predates the Great Mage War, the Kabal, and even the oldest known civilizations, Tritonath exists for a single purpose: to deny passage through the Empire's most strategically important fjord. The city is smaller than Aphroneth or Nepturon, but every cliff, wall, and tower has been built with defense in mind. The fjord itself forms a natural kill zone where enemy fleets are trapped beneath the guns, ballistae, and mages stationed high above. The ancient lighthouse remains one of Fragmenta's greatest mysteries — it still burns without fuel, keeper, or known mechanism.

fjordForum.name: The Fjord Forum
fjordForum.description: The city's administrative district overlooks the narrow waterway that gives Tritonath its purpose.

westernGate.name: The Western Gate
westernGate.description: The heavily fortified land entrance into Tritonath.

hallOfFjordCouncil.name: Hall of the Fjord Council
hallOfFjordCouncil.description: Seat of the city's Ascendus senator and administrative center for the western coast.

sentinelSquare.name: Sentinel Square
sentinelSquare.description: A disciplined public square where military announcements, civic ceremonies, and fleet celebrations are held.

coastalLedger.name: The Coastal Ledger
coastalLedger.description: Requests for coastal patrols, monster hunts, reconnaissance, and military contracts are posted here.

watchmansWard.name: Watchman's Ward
watchmansWard.description: Housing for soldiers, lighthouse attendants, and generations of families who have defended the fjord.

vigilisHeadquarters.name: Vigilis Headquarters
vigilisHeadquarters.description: Coordinates law enforcement and security throughout the city.

breakwaterMarket.name: Breakwater Market
breakwaterMarket.description: A practical marketplace serving soldiers, sailors, and travelers rather than wealthy merchants.

fjordExchange.name: The Fjord Exchange
fjordExchange.description: Stocks expedition supplies, preserved food, climbing equipment, and travel necessities.

stonewakeForge.name: Stonewake Forge
stonewakeForge.description: Produces dependable military weapons, siege hardware, anchors, and coastal defenses.

bastionArmory.name: Bastion Armory
bastionArmory.description: Crafts armor designed for harsh coastal weather and prolonged military campaigns.

tideglassApothecary.name: Tideglass Apothecary
tideglassApothecary.description: Specializes in cold-weather medicines, healing tonics, antidotes, and remedies for long sea voyages.

cliffStables.name: Cliff Stables
cliffStables.description: Maintains horses used by military couriers traveling inland.

beaconsRest.name: The Beacon's Rest
beaconsRest.description: A respected inn where sailors, scouts, and officers gather after long patrols.

coastTreasury.name: Coast Treasury
coastTreasury.description: Provides secure financial services for merchants, officers, and visiting travelers.

harborProvisioners.name: Harbor Provisioners
harborProvisioners.description: Coordinates civilian supplies entering the fortress city.

fjordBastion.name: The Fjord Bastion
fjordBastion.description: The largest district in Tritonath and the reason the city exists.

grandBastion.name: The Grand Bastion
grandBastion.description: The primary fortress commanding both sides of the fjord entrance.

hallOfDefenders.name: Hall of Defenders
hallOfDefenders.description: Strategic command center responsible for all western coastal defenses.

legionBarracks.name: Legion Barracks
legionBarracks.description: Housing for the permanent Legion garrison assigned to Tritonath.

siegeGrounds.name: Siege Grounds
siegeGrounds.description: Training fields for engineers, ballista crews, and coastal artillery.

westernArsenal.name: Western Arsenal
westernArsenal.description: Stores weapons, siege engines, ammunition, and defensive equipment.

quartermasterFortress.name: Quartermaster Fortress
quartermasterFortress.description: Coordinates military logistics throughout the western coastline.

houseOfRestoration.name: House of Restoration
houseOfRestoration.description: Treats wounded soldiers and sailors returning from patrol.

cliffSignalTower.name: Cliff Signal Tower
cliffSignalTower.description: Communicates with nearby forts using magical beacons and signal fires.

sacredPrecinct.name: The Sacred Precinct
sacredPrecinct.description: The sea is both protector and executioner. The faithful of Aqualis believe those who respect the waters may safely cross them, while those who underestimate them will inevitably be claimed.

grandTempleOfAqualis.name: The Grand Temple of Aqualis
grandTempleOfAqualis.description: The foremost temple of Aqualis in western Sanguivorum. Sailors, fishermen, and naval officers seek blessings before venturing onto the sea, while survivors return in gratitude for safe passage.

hallOfTwelve.name: Hall of the Twelve
hallOfTwelve.description: Contains twelve shrines honoring every deity of Fragmenta.

pilgrimsRest.name: Pilgrim's Rest
pilgrimsRest.description: Shelters pilgrims, sailors, and travelers making the coastal pilgrimage.

houseOfFaithful.name: House of the Faithful
houseOfFaithful.description: Residence of Tritonath's clergy and caretakers of the city's sacred traditions.

gardenOfReflection.name: Garden of Reflection
gardenOfReflection.description: A cliffside sanctuary where visitors contemplate the endless sea below.

sacredArchives.name: Sacred Archives
sacredArchives.description: Preserves centuries of maritime history, miracles, and religious records.

lighthouseConclave.name: Lighthouse Conclave
lighthouseConclave.description: The Kabal maintains a permanent presence in Tritonath to study the ancient lighthouse and defend the western coast — the official headquarters of the city's Conclave mages.

registryOfMariners.name: Registry of Mariners
registryOfMariners.description: Registers licensed maritime mages and magical navigators.

chamberOfTides.name: Chamber of Tides
chamberOfTides.description: Researches hydromancy, coastal weather, and defensive spellcraft.

archiveOfBeacon.name: Archive of the Beacon
archiveOfBeacon.description: Contains classified research concerning the ancient lighthouse and its unknown origins.

mageQuarters.name: Mage Quarters
mageQuarters.description: Housing for Conclave scholars assigned to Tritonath.

beaconCircle.name: Beacon Circle
beaconCircle.description: Reserved for sanctioned magical transportation. Like its counterparts at Zuevaron and Aphroneth, it stands ready for a network that doesn't yet exist.

harborDefenses.name: Harbor Defenses
harborDefenses.description: Unlike other ports, Tritonath's harbor exists primarily to support the military.

fortressHarbor.name: Fortress Harbor
fortressHarbor.description: Sheltered docks reserved for military vessels and authorized traffic.

customsHall.name: Customs Hall
customsHall.description: Inspects every ship entering the fjord.

militaryWarehouses.name: Military Warehouses
militaryWarehouses.description: Stores food, weapons, construction materials, and emergency provisions.

fleetSupplyDepot.name: Fleet Supply Depot
fleetSupplyDepot.description: Maintains supplies for patrol fleets operating along the western coast.

fishermansPier.name: Fisherman's Pier
fishermansPier.description: A modest civilian fishing harbor supporting the city's population.

stonewrightDistrict.name: Stonewright District
stonewrightDistrict.description: The craftsmen of Tritonath build fortifications meant to withstand centuries.

ironBreaker.name: The Iron Breaker
ironBreaker.description: Produces siege hardware, chains, anchors, and heavy military equipment.

masonsCrown.name: Mason's Crown
masonsCrown.description: Constructs the immense stone walls and towers that define Tritonath.

sailRopeHall.name: Sail & Rope Hall
sailRopeHall.description: Produces sails, rigging, banners, and expedition equipment.

beaconWorkshop.name: Beacon Workshop
beaconWorkshop.description: Crafts navigation tools, lenses, maps, and signal equipment.

timberHall.name: Timber Hall
timberHall.description: Produces siege timbers, dock structures, and military engineering supplies.

commandHeights.name: Command Heights
commandHeights.description: Perched atop the cliffs overlooking the fjord, this district houses Tritonath's senior leadership.

admiralsEstates.name: Admiral's Estates
admiralsEstates.description: Homes of retired admirals, commanders, and distinguished officers.

embassyHouse.name: Embassy House
embassyHouse.description: Limited diplomatic residences for foreign representatives.

defendersGarden.name: Defender's Garden
defendersGarden.description: A quiet memorial garden honoring those who died protecting the western coast.

hallOfCoastalHonor.name: Hall of Coastal Honor

victorath.name: Victorath
victorath.title: The City of the Victor's Crown
victorath.description: Where Marsatum is the shield that refuses to break, Victorath is the sword that strikes back. Built upon the site of one of Sanguivorum's greatest military victories, the city has become a monument to courage, sacrifice, and decisive leadership. Legion banners fly from every tower, triumphal arches commemorate legendary campaigns, and every citizen grows up hearing the stories of heroes who turned defeat into victory. It is the spiritual home of those who believe fortune favors the bold.

triumphForum.name: The Triumph Forum
triumphForum.description: The administrative heart of Victorath, where military tradition shapes civic life.

victorsGate.name: The Victor's Gate
victorsGate.description: A monumental gate adorned with reliefs depicting the city's founding victory.

hallOfTriumph.name: Hall of Triumph
hallOfTriumph.description: The seat of Victorath's Ascendus senator and the city's administrative authority.

victoryPlaza.name: Victory Plaza
victoryPlaza.description: A grand public square where military parades, commemorations, and civic celebrations are held.

victorsLedger.name: The Victor's Ledger
victorsLedger.description: Posts military commissions, escort contracts, bounty notices, reconnaissance missions, and civic requests.

legionnairesWard.name: Legionnaire's Ward
legionnairesWard.description: Home to decorated veterans, active officers, and families whose service spans generations.

crownVigilisHeadquarters.name: Crown Vigilis Headquarters
crownVigilisHeadquarters.description: The headquarters of Victorath's city watch and civil administration.

crownMarket.name: Crown Market
crownMarket.description: Commerce here serves soldiers, veterans, and travelers alike.

victorsSupply.name: The Victor's Supply
victorsSupply.description: Carries expedition equipment, military provisions, and quality travel goods.

crownforge.name: Crownforge
crownforge.description: Famous for producing finely balanced swords, polearms, and officer weapons worthy of champions.

goldenShield.name: The Golden Shield
goldenShield.description: Crafts ceremonial armor alongside battle-tested equipment for seasoned Legionnaires.

fortunesFlask.name: Fortune's Flask
fortunesFlask.description: Produces battlefield medicines, endurance tonics, and restorative elixirs.

victoryStables.name: Victory Stables
victoryStables.description: Maintains swift cavalry horses and dependable courier mounts.

laureledLion.name: The Laureled Lion
laureledLion.description: A celebrated inn where veterans recount campaigns and young recruits dream of earning their own glory.

triumphTreasury.name: Triumph Treasury
triumphTreasury.description: Provides secure financial services for officers, merchants, and visiting dignitaries.

merchantLegionGuild.name: Merchant Legion Guild
merchantLegionGuild.description: Coordinates trade supporting Victorath's military economy.

crownCitadel.name: The Crown Citadel
crownCitadel.description: The military soul of Victorath — the city's immense fortress and headquarters of its Legion command.

hallOfVictors.name: Hall of Victors
hallOfVictors.description: A chamber preserving battle honors, campaign records, and the names of legendary commanders.

legionBarracks.name: Legion Barracks
legionBarracks.description: Housing for Victorath's standing Legion garrison.

fieldOfChampions.name: Field of Champions
fieldOfChampions.description: Training grounds emphasizing aggressive tactics, dueling, and coordinated battlefield maneuvers.

crownArsenal.name: Crown Arsenal
crownArsenal.description: Stores weapons, armor, standards, and military equipment.

legionCommand.name: Legion Command
legionCommand.description: Coordinates regional military operations and officer deployments.

houseOfValor.name: House of Valor
houseOfValor.description: Provides care for wounded soldiers while honoring those who gave everything in service.

triumphTower.name: Triumph Tower
triumphTower.description: A commanding watchtower crowned by the city's ever-flying Legion standard.

sacredPrecinct.name: The Sacred Precinct
sacredPrecinct.description: The people of Victorath look to Veylana, believing that destiny is shaped by courage, resolve, and the willingness to seize the decisive moment.

grandTempleOfVeylana.name: The Grand Temple of Veylana
grandTempleOfVeylana.description: The foremost sanctuary dedicated to Veylana in Sanguivorum. Commanders seek guidance before campaigns, while victorious soldiers return to offer gratitude for fortune's favor.

hallOfTwelve.name: Hall of the Twelve
hallOfTwelve.description: Contains twelve shrines honoring every deity of Fragmenta.

pilgrimsRest.name: Pilgrim's Rest
pilgrimsRest.description: Provides lodging for pilgrims, veterans, and travelers.

gardenOfFortune.name: Garden of Fortune
gardenOfFortune.description: A peaceful memorial garden celebrating hope, destiny, and those whose courage changed history.

sacredArchives.name: Sacred Archives
sacredArchives.description: Preserves sacred texts, military blessings, and records of historic victories.

crownConclave.name: The Crown Conclave
crownConclave.description: The Kabal's regional headquarters studies battlefield magic, probability, and tactical arcana.

crownConclaveHall.name: Crown Conclave Hall
crownConclaveHall.description: Official headquarters of the Kabal within Victorath.

registryOfBattleMages.name: Registry of Battle Mages
registryOfBattleMages.description: Registers military spellcasters and licensed magical specialists.

chamberOfFortune.name: Chamber of Fortune
chamberOfFortune.description: Focuses on battlefield coordination, tactical spellcraft, and magical support.

archiveOfCampaigns.name: Archive of Campaigns
archiveOfCampaigns.description: Maintains magical records of famous battles and military research.

mageQuarters.name: Mage Quarters
mageQuarters.description: Housing for Conclave instructors and military mages.

victoryExchange.name: Victory Exchange
victoryExchange.description: A logistical district ensuring the city's military remains ready.

legionGate.name: Legion Gate
legionGate.description: Primary entrance for military caravans and official convoys.

militaryCustoms.name: Military Customs
militaryCustoms.description: Inspects supplies destined for regional forts and Legions.

victoryWarehouses.name: Victory Warehouses
victoryWarehouses.description: Stores provisions, weapons, uniforms, and reserve equipment.

quartermasterHall.name: Quartermaster Hall
quartermasterHall.description: Coordinates military logistics throughout the surrounding region.

supplyOffice.name: Supply Office
supplyOffice.description: Oversees transportation and distribution of essential resources.

caravanYard.name: Caravan Yard
caravanYard.description: A staging area for supply trains and merchant caravans.

laurelsWard.name: Laurels Ward
laurelsWard.description: Master craftsmen create equipment worthy of heroes.

victorsForge.name: Victor's Forge
victorsForge.description: Produces masterwork weapons commissioned for champions, officers, and distinguished adventurers.

stoneOfTriumph.name: Stone of Triumph
stoneOfTriumph.description: Constructs monuments, memorials, and military architecture.

standardWeaver.name: Standard Weaver
standardWeaver.description: Produces Legion banners, ceremonial cloaks, and formal military attire.

medalwrightHall.name: Medalwright Hall
medalwrightHall.description: Crafts medals, signet rings, ceremonial decorations, and officer insignia.

championsWorkshop.name: Champion's Workshop
championsWorkshop.description: Produces custom military equipment and commemorative works.

legionCarpenter.name: Legion Carpenter
legionCarpenter.description: Builds wagons, siege equipment, bridges, and military infrastructure.

victorsHeights.name: Victor's Heights
victorsHeights.description: Home to Victorath's commanders, decorated heroes, and respected civic leaders.

heroesEstates.name: Hero's Estates
heroesEstates.description: Homes of distinguished generals, decorated veterans, and influential families.

embassyHall.name: Embassy Hall
embassyHall.description: Hosts diplomatic representatives and military observers.

gardenOfHeroes.name: Garden of Heroes
gardenOfHeroes.description: A beautifully maintained memorial honoring those whose actions secured the Empire's greatest victories.

hallOfLaurels.name: Hall of Laurels
hallOfLaurels.description: The Empire's highest civic hall for recognizing acts of extraordinary courage and leadership.

commandersCircle.name: Commander's Circle
commandersCircle.description: An exclusive gathering place where generals, governors, and honored veterans share strategy and fellowship.

crownOfVictory.name: The Crown of Victory
crownOfVictory.description: A colossal triumphal arch commemorating the battle that gave Victorath its name.

eternalStandard.name: The Eternal Standard
eternalStandard.description: A towering Legion banner that is never lowered, representing the enduring spirit of Sanguivorum.

heroesWalk.name: Hero's Walk
heroesWalk.description: A grand boulevard lined with statues of the Empire's greatest champions.

fieldOfTriumph.name: The Field of Triumph
fieldOfTriumph.description: The preserved battlefield where Victorath's defining victory was won, now serving as both memorial and place of study.

fallenFortress.name: The Fallen Fortress
fallenFortress.description: The ruined enemy stronghold captured during Victorath's founding campaign, now hiding forgotten passages and lingering dangers.

championsCrypt.name: Champion's Crypt
championsCrypt.description: The burial place of legendary heroes, protected by ancient wards and sacred tradition.

oldEncampment.name: The Old Encampment
oldEncampment.description: The preserved remains of the Legion camp from the city's founding battle.

victoryTrail.name: The Victory Trail
victoryTrail.description: A commemorative route following the decisive movements of the historic campaign.

scoutCommand.name: Scout Command
scoutCommand.description: A forward command post dispatching reconnaissance missions, patrols, and frontier investigations.

heroesSummit.name: Hero's Summit
heroesSummit.description: A high ridge overlooking Victorath and the historic battlefield, offering one of the most inspiring views in western Sanguivorum.

the_rivers_gate.name: The River's Gate
the_rivers_gate.description: The northern threshold of Vaeloris, where the Sylvara river begins its run south and the Kabal keeps a sovereign bridge that answers to neither nation on its banks. Ask no questions about what crosses at night.

connections.desc: downriver, 6 days by boat, 28 by foot

the_crossing.name: The Crossing
the_crossing.description: A border town built around the Kabal's own sovereign bridge — the only crossing into Sanguivorum that answers to neither nation. Logged crossings and actual crossings aren't always the same thing here, and everyone on both banks knows it.

sylmere.name: Sylmere
sylmere.description: A river town on the Sylvara, its docks built to elven proportions that make everyone else feel slightly too large for their boots.

the_arbor.name: The Arbor
the_arbor.description: The largest tree in existence, and the seat of Sylvorn Vaelithar's rule over the triarchy of elves, lizardfolk, and dragonborn. The Witnessed watch from somewhere in its upper branches, and if you stand still long enough you start to feel watched back — not unkindly.

hollow.name: The Root Hollow
hollow.description: A rest-house grown into the Arbor's own roots rather than built beside them — elven carpenters shaped the wood centuries ago and it's simply kept growing since. Sleep here and you half-dream of rings countable in the walls.

market.name: The Canopy Market
market.description: Stalls strung between lower branches and reached by rope bridge, trading in elven, lizardfolk, and dragonborn goods side by side — the one place in the triarchy where all three actually barter face to face.

boughs.name: The Witnessed Boughs
boughs.description: Climb high enough and the upper branches go quiet in a way that isn't natural silence. The Witnessed are said to keep council somewhere up here; you never quite see them, but standing still long enough, you feel seen back.

the_meadows_sentinel.name: The Meadow's Sentinel
the_meadows_sentinel.description: A watch-town at the forest's northeastern edge, named for the standing stone said to mark where the meadows end and the elves' authority begins.

drathmere.name: Drathmere
drathmere.description: A river town further south along the Sylvara than Sylmere, where the current starts to slow and the forest starts thinking about becoming swamp.

the_confluence.name: The Confluence
the_confluence.description: A floating lizardfolk city where the Sylvara's manageable stretch ends and the deep wetland begins. Below here, the terrain stops caring what you brought a map for.

drath_vorrumbruk.name: Drath Vorrumbruk
drath_vorrumbruk.description: The deep swamp. Lizardfolk call it home and guide it; no one else finds their way through without one. Somewhere in its heart lives Druith — the Ancient — a crocodile that declined to stop growing and has thus far declined to die. The Great Lizard is said to speak here in a language older than the nations.

the_swamps_near.name: The Swamp's Heart
the_swamps_near.description: A hidden lizardfolk settlement built around what the outside world isn't told is a hatchery. Outsiders who find it are usually meant to.

the_repose.name: The Repose
the_repose.description: A quiet clearing town, popular with elven pilgrims for reasons no one explains to outsiders and outsiders have learned not to ask about twice.

the_red_hold.name: The Red Hold
the_red_hold.description: An undefeated fortress deep in Vaeloris forest, garrisoned by the Rooted Legion. No army has ever taken it and, by the look of the walls, none ever will.

connections.desc: continuous forest, no terrain relief, into Thraekor

sahurim.name: Sahurim
sahurim.description: A major desert hub built on caravan roads and the certainty that water is worth more than gold. The bridge road to Arethon runs straight through the Desert War's stalemated front.

connections.desc: elevation gain in the final stretch
the bridge road, through the Desert War front
