tavern.name: The Waterworth Rest
tavern.description: A rest-house that charges for its water before it charges for the room, per Sahrimor custom — pay it without complaint and the innkeeper warms up considerably. Caravan guards trade war-front rumors over lukewarm tea.

market.name: The Caravan Bazaar
market.description: A sprawl of stalls that never fully closes, restocked by whichever caravan rolled in most recently. Everything's priced in water-equivalents first, gold second — a habit that confuses outsiders and no one bothers explaining.

cistern.name: The Cistern Court
cistern.description: The public cistern and the law court that governs it share the same courtyard, deliberately — water disputes here get settled in view of the water itself. The Merchant King's seal is stamped on every rationing notice.

nyssara.name: Nyssara
nyssara.description: House Massa runs the commercial infrastructure here, at the terminus of the short bridge crossing to Kolven on Norrvael. Water guides for hire, if you can afford their rates.

connections.desc: no guide will take you further than the edge

black_sands.name: The Black Sands
black_sands.description: The sand underfoot is the color of char, and the cold has no business existing this deep in a desert. Whatever swallowed the expeditions that came looking for what's buried here didn't need to chase them — most of them walked in on their own.

nocthera.name: Nocthera
nocthera.description: An isolated mountain-mass city at Sahrimor's far northern reach, cold in a way the rest of the nation refuses to believe. It's also headquarters to the Mugamiir Safor — the largest adventuring guild on the continent, founded a hundred thirty years ago by the survivors of the first serious Black Sands expedition. They predate Sahrimor as a formal nation, and act like it.

iskara.name: Iskara
iskara.description: A cold frontier town past Nocthera, the last waypoint before the continent's northern edge stops being mapped in any useful detail.

thalvora.name: Thalvora
thalvora.description: A prosperous plateau city, its markets stacked with cut gems and its paddocks loud with horses and animals traded nowhere else in Sahrimor. The most stable of the Merchant King's eight satellites — the Orange Lord wants their plateau kept exactly as it is, not the crown.

kharzun.name: Kharzun
kharzun.description: A canyon city built vertically into the rock, its switchback approach impassable to anything with wheels. Camels only, and a head for heights.

eryndor.name: Eryndor
eryndor.description: A desert waypoint east of Kharzun, quiet except when the caravan season peaks.

nerivon.name: Nerivon
nerivon.description: A small trade town near Sahrimor's eastern edge.

zypherra.name: Zypherra
zypherra.description: A desert market town near the southern trade roads, close enough to Nyssara that the two cities' gossip arrives a day apart.

khar_veth.name: Khar-Veth
khar_veth.description: A clan territory at the transitional edge where Vaeloris forest gives way to Thraekor stone. Pace improves noticeably heading south from here.

connections.desc: the official crossing back into Vaeloris

dunnrak.name: Dunnrak
dunnrak.description: Thraekor's official overland border crossing, controlled by the Keth-Orn clan. Terms of passage have changed three times in the last decade — check before you commit to a route.

thurak.name: Thurak
thurak.description: A transitional waypoint city, still solid ground, the volcanic interior's danger a rumor here rather than a daily fact.

velm.name: Velm
velm.description: A dwarven town on the edge of the true volcanic interior, where every local knows exactly which ground is safe and shares that knowledge with almost no one.

vorreth.name: Vorreth
vorreth.description: A hold town deep enough in the ash fields that visitors are quietly counted on the way in and on the way out. Also home to the Magma-Hearth Guild — Thraekor's mercenary institution, formally independent of the clans, expected to support confederation wars at discount rather than for free. Its heavy infantry and siege specialists are the guild's calling card, and its long-running rivalry with Sahrimor's Mugamiir Safor is commercial, not personal — though both sides watch the other closely.

tavern.name: The Ash-Counted Hearth
tavern.description: Named half for the volcanic hearth-fires and half for the count kept on everyone who passes through — visitors are logged coming in and logged again going out, and the innkeeper does both without seeming to look up.

market.name: The Cinder Market
market.description: Stalls set back from the ash-fall line, trading in what the mercenary trade actually needs: rations, rope, and gear that can survive a march through live volcanic ground.

guildhall.name: The Magma-Hearth Guildhall
guildhall.description: Seat of the Magma-Hearth Guild — Thraekor's mercenary institution, heavy infantry and siege specialists first, everything else second. Contract boards line the entry hall, updated the moment a confederation war needs bodies.

khar_dunn.name: Khar-Dunn
khar_dunn.description: A contested bridge stronghold near the volcano's shoulder, close enough to the lava fields that ashfall is just weather here.

connections.desc: sea exit often faster than continuing overland

khar_athel.name: Khar-Athel
khar_athel.description: The Stillwarden's seat, built against the shoulder of the active volcano the whole Confederation is named for its ashes. The Ash Principle is carved somewhere in every wall here — what remains after everything burns.

ashvel.name: Ashvel
ashvel.description: A Low Hold coastal city, one of only two points where Thraekor trades by sea. A two-day coastal hop reaches Keth-Dur.

keth_dur.name: Keth-Dur
keth_dur.description: Thraekor's other primary sea-trade point, and the most-used dwarf-to-island crossing on the continent — a short strait run to the Skarveld bridge on Norrvael.

drak_torr.name: Drak-Torr
drak_torr.description: A city-state hold cut into the lava-field foothills, its garrison older than the current Ritual Vote cycle and loyal mostly to itself.

skorrvel.name: Skorrvel
skorrvel.description: A smaller city-state hold on the ash-field fringe, its clan's independence more a matter of nobody bothering to contest it than any real strength.

kolven.name: Kolven
kolven.description: Norrvael's northern bridgehead, terminus of the short crossing from Nyssara. Everything that passes here is logged; the garrison commander's word on what's permitted is final and not up for debate.

drakenholm.name: Drakenholm
drakenholm.description: Seat of House Dravenkov, and — if the oldest stories are true — named for a dragon that still sleeps somewhere beneath the mountains here, slowly waking. Empress Violetta Dravenkov rules from the cliff-hall above the canyon road.

tavern.name: The Sleeping Wyrm
tavern.description: Named for the dragon the old stories say sleeps under the mountains here, slowly waking. Regulars swear the floor hums some nights. The innkeeper swears it's just the cellar, and pours another round before anyone can ask twice.

market.name: The Canyon Road Bazaar
market.description: Stalls lining the switchback where the canyon road opens into the city proper — the island's commercial spine ends here, so whatever Norrvael trades in eventually passes through this market.

cliffhall.name: The Cliff-Hall
cliffhall.description: Empress Violetta Dravenkov's seat, built into the cliff face above the canyon road so the whole city has to look up to see it. House Dravenkov business is conducted here, and very little of it is explained to outsiders.

runholm.name: Runholm
runholm.description: A well-maintained canyon-road town, comfortably the easiest place on the island to just be a traveler for a while.

askveld.name: Askveld
askveld.description: A managed-forest region on Norrvael's canyon-road network, its timber carefully rationed by House Dravenkov decree.

isthvar.name: Isthvar
isthvar.description: A high plateau built to be difficult to reach, and successful at it. Whatever's up here chose the isolation on purpose.

vorrkar.name: Vorrkar
vorrkar.description: A southwestern settlement, deliberately hard to reach, same as Isthvar — Norrvael seems to prefer it that way.

skarveld.name: Skarveld
skarveld.description: The western bridge terminus, facing the strait crossing back to Keth-Dur on the Thraekor coast.

stormven.name: Stormven
stormven.description: A branch settlement off the Kolven-Drakenholm canyon spine, its harbor watching an open stretch of ocean that no local captain will name a destination for.

stoneback_beetle.name: Stoneback Beetle
stoneback_beetle.description: A fist-sized, dark-shelled beetle, faintly luminescent at the abdomen. Rarely a threat alone — but corner a nest and hundreds of simultaneous defensive bites can kill an unprepared traveler.
stoneback_beetle.combatNotes: Swarms when threatened. Smoke is the best deterrent.

mirrorfish.name: Mirrorfish
mirrorfish.description: An ordinary-looking silver fish whose scales reflect magical workings back at whoever cast them. Not dangerous — the river it swims in might be.

gloomhawk.name: Gloomhawk
gloomhawk.description: An eagle-sized raptor that dampens magic in a radius around itself and remembers every face that's wronged it — sometimes for days, sometimes across a continent.
gloomhawk.combatNotes: Suppresses magic nearby. Holds grudges; avoid provoking it twice.

cave_scorpion.name: Cave Scorpion
cave_scorpion.description: No longer than a forearm, but the venom is the danger, not the creature — effects vary sharply by region, from Sanguivorum's numbing-paralysis progression to Norrvael's blood-freezing sting.
cave_scorpion.combatNotes: Venom effect varies by region. Treat promptly.

ridgeback_boar.name: Ridgeback Boar
ridgeback_boar.description: An ordinary boar with a crystalline ridge running spine to tusk. Elders learn the Somersault Charge — rolling the ridge in as a piercing weapon that goes through armor.
ridgeback_boar.combatNotes: Scarred adults may Somersault Charge — do not stand in a straight line with one.

thornhide.name: Thornhide
thornhide.description: A lizard that grows very large and armors itself with age. The bite carries a bacterial load that kills through infection faster than through damage.
thornhide.combatNotes: Clean any bite wound immediately and completely.

veilwing.name: Veilwing
veilwing.description: A large cold-loving moth whose wing-dust is a dose-response sedative. It will not chase you — it will put you to sleep where you stand if you give it reason to.
veilwing.combatNotes: Heavy exposure to wing dust causes fatal sleep. Fight from distance or not at all.

ashwyrm.name: Ashwyrm
ashwyrm.description: A small slate-grey serpent with six retractable fangs, each carrying a distinct venom — combined, they convert blood to ash. Considered the deadliest small creature on the continent.
ashwyrm.combatNotes: A complete bite is fatal within minutes without antivenom. Avoid engagement entirely if possible.

plainswolf.name: Plainswolf
plainswolf.description: Larger than an ordinary wolf, hunting in near-silent, well-coordinated packs of up to ten under a single alpha.
plainswolf.combatNotes: Pack tactics — isolating one from the pack is dangerous.

river_serpent.name: River Serpent
river_serpent.description: An 18-22 foot aquatic constrictor whose shimmering scales exert a subtle compulsion, drawing onlookers toward the water without their noticing.
river_serpent.combatNotes: Discharges an electrical shock at close range before striking. Don't linger at the water's edge distracted.

thunderbird.name: Thunderbird
thunderbird.description: A massive storm-grey raptor that generates its own localized, self-sustaining thunderstorm and can direct lightning at specific targets when threatened.
thunderbird.combatNotes: Never approach during an active or building storm.

drake.name: Drake
drake.description: Diminished dragon-kin, reasoning and individual, common only in Norrvael. Breath type — fire, ice, acid, lightning, or scalding mist — is tied to parentage, not color.
drake.combatNotes: Genuinely intelligent; may be reasoned with, tested, or bonded rather than fought.

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.description: Vast, ancient, and only four credible successful combat engagements ever recorded. Withdrawal is the recommended encounter protocol, not engagement.
dragon.combatNotes: Extreme danger. Fewer than a handful of parties have ever survived a fight with one.

vampire_turned.name: The Turned
vampire_turned.description: The first stage of the vampiric condition — still human in mind, growing irritable and blood-aware. Treatable within 48 hours of infection.
vampire_turned.combatNotes: Treat quickly: sunlight, blessed water, or Faith-path healing before the window closes.

vampire_lesser.name: A Lesser
vampire_lesser.description: Feral and tactically dangerous, drawn to its own kind, subordinate to any Full-Blood nearby.
vampire_lesser.combatNotes: Never engage alone. Eliminate flight capability first.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.description: Reanimated bone, silent and mechanical in its violence. A carved sigil bone anchors the animation.
skeleton.combatNotes: Target the sigil bone at the center of mass, or eliminate the necromancer maintaining it.

zombie.name: Zombie
zombie.description: Slow, aggressive, and dangerous mainly in numbers — fragments of undifferentiated spirit-material forced into dead flesh.
zombie.combatNotes: Decapitation is the most reliable kill.

animated_armor.name: Animated Armour
animated_armor.description: Worked metal given motion by enchantment carved directly into the plate. Higher tiers can adapt tactics mid-fight.
animated_armor.combatNotes: Fire is the universal answer — enough heat distorts the metal and fails the enchantment.

golem_stone.name: Stone Golem
golem_stone.description: A construct of animated stone, the most durable of the golem-kinds, requiring no maintenance if undamaged.
golem_stone.combatNotes: Slow but relentless. No reasoning with it — check control status before engaging.

elemental_fire.name: Fire Elemental
elemental_fire.description: A spontaneous coalescence of magical saturation given flame and humanoid form. Fights with weapon and spell simultaneously.
elemental_fire.combatNotes: Must go fully physical to heal — force the choice between fighting and reconstituting.

elemental_ice.name: Ice Elemental
elemental_ice.description: A coalescence of cold and magical density given shape. Proximity alone is hazardous.
elemental_ice.combatNotes: Fire and sustained heat are the effective counters.

banshee.name: Banshee
banshee.description: Not a creature so much as a calcified stone holding the compressed dead of an unburied battlefield, projecting a spirit-form drawn from their memory.
banshee.combatNotes: Conventional combat is nearly useless. Destroy the stone at range with magic, or don't engage.

wraith.name: Wraith
wraith.description: A spirit that refused to cross the river at death, both hands permanently over its ruined face, hunting the places it remembers from life.
wraith.combatNotes: Burn its physical remains before engaging if you can find them. Never fight one alone.

stitched.name: The Stitched
stitched.description: A body assembled from many bodies by an outlawed Bruised mage, driven by one or more carved hearts. Feels no pain.
stitched.combatNotes: Every heart must be destroyed. Fire, shock, and cutting alone do nothing to stop it.

diamond_tail.name: Diamond Tail
diamond_tail.description: A living geological formation of fused rock and flesh, the size of a house, tipped in a tail it deliberately wields as a weapon.
diamond_tail.combatNotes: Not recommended without coordinated military and mage support. Territorial, not a hunter.

druith.name: Druith, the Ancient
druith.description: An impossibly old crocodile that declined to stop growing and has, so far, declined to die. Scales harder than worked metal. Protected fiercely by the lizardfolk — never approach without their escort.
druith.combatNotes: Nearly immobile on land unless truly provoked. Never enter the water near it unescorted.

maur_rau.name: The Ancient Flyer
maur_rau.description: The largest known flying creature, armored in relics of a forgotten civilization, circumnavigating the continent on a slow, mappable circuit. Ignores everything beneath it except when feeding.
maur_rau.combatNotes: Not hunting people. Move laterally if it's descending near you; it will not alter course.

vaelorn.name: Vaelorn, a Grove Warden
vaelorn.description: In stillness, an ancient tree. In motion, a tall bark-covered figure that has never been documented to harm a person, and often heals them unasked.
vaelorn.combatNotes: Not a combat encounter. If a corrupted grove is ever found, its undead should never be approached alone.

kabal_enforcer.name: A Kabal Enforcer Patrol
kabal_enforcer.description: Kabal-trained enforcers, sent to bring in an unregistered practitioner — you — dead or restrained, whichever comes first.
kabal_enforcer.combatNotes: Winning doesn't clear your name. It just buys you time before the next patrol.

dregnar_ashvein.name: Dregnar Ashvein
dregnar_ashvein.native: Gods' Hand Kabal / Veranthari — First Sword of the Tower
dregnar_ashvein.description: An Aqua/Cryo warrior-mage in distinctive silver Kar'Mhal plate, Ashquench — an unquenched dwarven maul completed by magically reinforced black ice — resting easy in one hand.
dregnar_ashvein.combatNotes: He opens guarded, a shifting water barrier turning aside whatever he can't yet afford to answer. Give him an opening and he closes it; corner him and he stops holding back.

street_bandit.name: Street Bandit
street_bandit.description: An opportunist working the back alleys and closed-up storefronts of a city's rougher quarters — quick with a knife, quicker to run if a fight turns against them.
street_bandit.combatNotes: Rarely alone. Watch for a second one covering the exit.

hired_blade.name: Hired Blade
hired_blade.description: A professional, not a desperate one — mercenaries who've traded a Legion or guild contract for whatever a client in a city's underworld is willing to pay instead.
hired_blade.combatNotes: Better trained and better armed than a street bandit. Don't mistake the calm for hesitation.

watch_patrol.name: Watch Patrol
watch_patrol.description: Ordinary city guards — not corrupt, not rogue, just doing their job. That job becomes fighting you the moment you're wanted or your standing turns hostile; otherwise they never draw on you at all.
watch_patrol.combatNotes: Trained and organized. Expect more than one, and expect them to actually coordinate.

wildBoar.name: Wild Boar
wildBoar.description: Small by comparison to its kin, but fearless once cornered.
wildBoar.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

razorback.name: Razorback
razorback.description: Scarred by countless battles, its hide punishes reckless attackers.
razorback.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

direBoar.name: Dire Boar
direBoar.description: Its charge has shattered shields and broken battle lines.
direBoar.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

ironTusk.name: Iron Tusk
ironTusk.description: Its massive tusks can pierce even the toughest armor.
ironTusk.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

tuskKing.name: Tusk King
tuskKing.description: The undisputed ruler of every sounder within its territory.
tuskKing.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

blackBear.name: Black Bear
blackBear.description: Usually content to avoid conflict, but once provoked it becomes surprisingly relentless.
blackBear.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

brownBear.name: Brown Bear
brownBear.description: A mountain of muscle that shrugs off injuries capable of killing lesser beasts.
brownBear.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

polarBear.name: Polar Bear
polarBear.description: The frozen north belongs to those strong enough to survive it.
polarBear.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

caveBear.name: Cave Bear
caveBear.description: Ancient instincts and immense strength make every charge a deadly gamble.
caveBear.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

greatMatriarchBear.name: Great Matriarch Bear
greatMatriarchBear.description: Countless cubs have walked beneath her shadow. Countless hunters have vanished within her domain.
greatMatriarchBear.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

timberWolf.name: Timber Wolf
timberWolf.description: A relentless pack hunter that thrives through coordination rather than strength.
timberWolf.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

direWolf.name: Dire Wolf
direWolf.description: Twice the size of its common cousin.
direWolf.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

duskWolf.name: Dusk Wolf
duskWolf.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

frostWolf.name: Frost Wolf
frostWolf.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

ashWolf.name: Ash Wolf
ashWolf.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

emeraldWolf.name: Emerald Wolf
emeraldWolf.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

duneWolf.name: Dune Wolf
duneWolf.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

crimsonWolf.name: Crimson Wolf
crimsonWolf.description: The scent of blood drives it into a frenzy.
crimsonWolf.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

alphaWolf.name: Alpha Wolf
alphaWolf.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

ancientWolf.name: Ancient Wolf
ancientWolf.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

giantRat.name: Giant Rat
giantRat.description: Alone it is little more than a nuisance. Together they become a tide of teeth.
giantRat.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

caveRat.name: Cave Rat
caveRat.description: Centuries beneath the earth have made these rodents unnervingly persistent.
caveRat.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

direBeaver.name: Dire Beaver
direBeaver.description: Powerful jaws capable of reducing trees to splinters make it surprisingly dangerous.
direBeaver.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

giantPorcupine.name: Giant Porcupine
giantPorcupine.description: Predators quickly learn that every successful attack comes at a price.
giantPorcupine.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

burrowKing.name: Burrow King
burrowKing.description: The largest rodent ever recorded. Entire tunnel networks form around its domain.
burrowKing.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

wildcat.name: Wildcat
wildcat.description: A nimble predator that relies on speed and precision over strength.
wildcat.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

lynx.name: Lynx
lynx.description: Patient hunters that become deadlier the longer they are ignored.
lynx.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

panther.name: Panther
panther.description: A powerful forest predator that strikes healthy prey with terrifying force.
panther.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

mountainLion.name: Mountain Lion
mountainLion.description: A relentless hunter that refuses to abandon its chosen prey.
mountainLion.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

lion.name: Lion
lion.description: The dominant leader of a pride whose presence emboldens nearby felines.
lion.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

sabertooth.name: Sabertooth
sabertooth.description: A prehistoric predator capable of crushing even heavily defended opponents.
sabertooth.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

ancientSabertooth.name: Ancient Sabertooth
ancientSabertooth.description: The undisputed apex terrestrial predator of the wild.
ancientSabertooth.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

baboon.name: Baboon
baboon.description: Small, loud, and fearless in groups, a baboon will harass creatures many times its size.
baboon.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

chimpanzee.name: Chimpanzee
chimpanzee.description: Curiosity and cunning make it far deadlier than its size suggests.
chimpanzee.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

gorilla.name: Gorilla
gorilla.description: A massive primate whose presence alone unsettles predators.
gorilla.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

greatApe.name: Great Ape
greatApe.description: Years of survival have forged a terrifyingly adaptable fighter.
greatApe.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

greatWhiteApe.name: Great White Ape
greatWhiteApe.description: A legendary white-furred ape that wields a massive hardwood club with frightening precision.
greatWhiteApe.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

terrorBird.name: Terror Bird
terrorBird.description: A towering flightless predator that outruns nearly anything on two legs.
terrorBird.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

duneOwl.name: Dune Owl
duneOwl.description: A giant pale owl that hunts beneath moonlight with unnerving precision.
duneOwl.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

shrike.name: Shrike
shrike.description: A wolf-sized predatory bird that impales prey before feeding.
shrike.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

boneRoc.name: Bone Roc
boneRoc.description: A massive mountain predator capable of carrying away livestock.
boneRoc.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

marshCrocodile.name: Marsh Crocodile
marshCrocodile.description: An ambush predator lurking beneath still waters.
marshCrocodile.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

riverCrocodile.name: River Crocodile
riverCrocodile.description: Larger and more aggressive, dominating broad rivers.
riverCrocodile.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

giantCrocodile.name: Giant Crocodile
giantCrocodile.description: A prehistoric monster capable of dragging large prey beneath the water.
giantCrocodile.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

theFirstScale.name: The First Scale
theFirstScale.description: A towering reptilian beast revered by some Lizardfolk traditions as the First Scale. Whether ancestor or coincidence remains fiercely debated.
theFirstScale.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

giantSerpent.name: Giant Serpent
giantSerpent.description: Large enough to consume a grown human whole, it waits with unnerving patience before striking.
giantSerpent.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

elderSerpent.name: Elder Serpent
elderSerpent.description: Its coils can snap bone and its patience borders on unnatural.
elderSerpent.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

titanSerpent.name: Titan Serpent
titanSerpent.description: Entire expeditions vanish after wandering into a Titan Serpent’s territory.
titanSerpent.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

worldSerpent.name: World Serpent
worldSerpent.description: So immense that travelers mistake portions of its body for fallen trees until the earth itself begins to move.
worldSerpent.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

youngAkharu.name: Young Akharu
youngAkharu.description: A scorpion-kin still growing into its armor, but its sting is already lethal.
youngAkharu.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

akharu.name: Akharu
akharu.description: A fully-grown giant scorpion of the Black Sands, plated in sun-baked chitin.
akharu.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

greatAkharu.name: Great Akharu
greatAkharu.description: A titan among scorpions, deep within the Black Sands, that drags prey underground before it can scream.
greatAkharu.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

akharuMatriarch.name: Akharu Matriarch
akharuMatriarch.description: The ruler of an entire Black Sands nest, ancient and merciless, said to sense a threat leagues before it arrives.
akharuMatriarch.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

greaterDhulorvae.name: Greater Dhulorvae
greaterDhulorvae.description: A larger cousin of the common cave scorpion, its venom potent enough to drop prey twice its size.
greaterDhulorvae.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

elderDhulorvae.name: Elder Dhulorvae
elderDhulorvae.description: Old enough that its carapace has hardened past scarring, lurking in the deepest forgotten caverns.
elderDhulorvae.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

wildKethRhovael.name: Wild Keth-Rhovael
wildKethRhovael.description: A larger, more aggressive beetle that hunts in small swarms rather than the common nest-defense clusters.
wildKethRhovael.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

kethRhovaelGuardian.name: Keth-Rhovael Guardian
kethRhovaelGuardian.description: A heavily-armored beetle bred by the nest for one purpose — standing between danger and the Queen's chamber.
kethRhovaelGuardian.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

kethRhovaelQueen.name: Keth-Rhovael Queen
kethRhovaelQueen.description: The mother of an entire nest, rarely seen outside her deep chamber and never seen without an escort of her kin.
kethRhovaelQueen.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

juvenileDravenDrak.name: Juvenile Draven-Drak
juvenileDravenDrak.description: Young by dragon standards, but already large enough to level a hillside outpost.
juvenileDravenDrak.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

adultDravenDrak.name: Adult Draven-Drak
adultDravenDrak.description: Fully grown and territorial, ruling entire mountain ranges by reputation alone.
adultDravenDrak.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

youngSkrelDrak.name: Young Skrel-Drak
youngSkrelDrak.description: Diminished dragon-kin barely past adolescence, already capable of clearing a mountain pass alone.
youngSkrelDrak.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

ancientSkrelDrak.name: Ancient Skrel-Drak
ancientSkrelDrak.description: An old sovereign of its kind, ruling sacred nesting grounds that no outsider has ever mapped and returned from.
ancientSkrelDrak.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

valdrekKethLarva.name: Valdrek-Keth Larva
valdrekKethLarva.description: A fist-sized crystalline scorpion-kin, swarming in the ash fields in numbers that make up for its fragile shell.
valdrekKethLarva.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

valdrekKethHunter.name: Valdrek-Keth Hunter
valdrekKethHunter.description: Grown past its larval fragility, its crystal-plated tail now a weapon in its own right.
valdrekKethHunter.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

valdrekKethBroodQueen.name: Valdrek-Keth Brood Queen
valdrekKethBroodQueen.description: Ruler of a crystal brood cavern, encased in a shell said to be harder than worked diamond.
valdrekKethBroodQueen.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

elderVorethMauth.name: Elder Voreth-Mauth
elderVorethMauth.description: An old, larger moth of the frozen groves, its wing-dust thick enough to drop prey without a single touch.
elderVorethMauth.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

elderVorethSael.name: Elder Voreth-Sael
elderVorethSael.description: An ancient mirror-scaled fish said to live in sacred springs, its reflection dangerous long before its bite is.
elderVorethSael.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

elderLorvaunNauri.name: Elder Lorvaun-Nauri
elderLorvaunNauri.description: A scarred boar elder whose crystalline ridge has hardened into a weapon it now knows how to truly use.
elderLorvaunNauri.combatNotes: Learned the Somersault Charge — do not stand in a straight line with one.

rauThaulnThaun.name: Rau-Thauln Thaun
rauThaulnThaun.description: A hulking apex predator of the ancient forests, its mere presence enough to break a lesser hunter's nerve.
rauThaulnThaun.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

ancientRauThaulnThaun.name: Ancient Rau-Thauln Thaun
ancientRauThaulnThaun.description: Old enough to have outlived the forgotten kingdom it now hunts through, feared even by its own kind.
ancientRauThaulnThaun.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

rauThaulnMaur.name: Rau-Thauln Maur
rauThaulnMaur.description: A lean black-sands hunter that seems to flicker out of existence and reappear a stride closer.
rauThaulnMaur.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

elderRauThaulnMaur.name: Elder Rau-Thauln Maur
elderRauThaulnMaur.description: Its blink has sharpened into something closer to true displacement — blink and it is already behind you.
elderRauThaulnMaur.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

ancientRauThaulnMaur.name: Ancient Rau-Thauln Maur
ancientRauThaulnMaur.description: A legend among the deep dunes — hunters swear it can be in two places within the same breath.
ancientRauThaulnMaur.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

rauThaulnRavek.name: Rau-Thauln Ravek
rauThaulnRavek.description: A lava-tube burrower that collapses the ground beneath its prey before it ever shows itself.
rauThaulnRavek.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

elderRauThaulnRavek.name: Elder Rau-Thauln Ravek
elderRauThaulnRavek.description: Old enough to have mapped an entire volcanic cavern system in its own tunnels.
elderRauThaulnRavek.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

ancientRauThaulnRavek.name: Ancient Rau-Thauln Ravek
ancientRauThaulnRavek.description: Commands an entire living tunnel network beneath the lava fields, striking from wherever it pleases.
ancientRauThaulnRavek.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

rauThaulnVaelin.name: Rau-Thauln Vaelin
rauThaulnVaelin.description: A canopy hunter of the great forests, dropping onto prey from branches high overhead.
rauThaulnVaelin.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

elderRauThaulnVaelin.name: Elder Rau-Thauln Vaelin
elderRauThaulnVaelin.description: A ruler of the Worldroot canopy, whose first strike is rarely survived by anything smaller.
elderRauThaulnVaelin.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

rauThaulnVoreth.name: Rau-Thauln Voreth
rauThaulnVoreth.description: A frost-pale hunter of the boreal snowfields whose exact position is never quite where it looks.
rauThaulnVoreth.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

elderRauThaulnVoreth.name: Elder Rau-Thauln Voreth
elderRauThaulnVoreth.description: Its illusion has perfected past mere misdirection — glacial passes are said to hold a dozen of it at once, all false but one.
elderRauThaulnVoreth.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

dreadroot.name: Dreadroot
dreadroot.description: What became of Vaelorn's grove after the corruption took root — a twisted, half-animate mass of blighted wood.
dreadroot.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

lesserElemental.name: Lesser Elemental
lesserElemental.description: A small, roughly humanoid mass of animated matter — its exact substance depends entirely on where it was formed.
lesserElemental.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

elemental.name: Elemental
elemental.description: A fully-formed elemental, dense and coherent enough to hold its shape indefinitely.
elemental.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

greaterElemental.name: Greater Elemental
greaterElemental.description: Old and dense enough that its manifest and ethereal forms are both stable — a rare, dangerous balance.
greaterElemental.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

primalElemental.name: Primal Elemental
primalElemental.description: A primordial fragment, older than the elements it's made of ever having had names.
primalElemental.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

rootSulDaun.name: Root Sul-Daun
rootSulDaun.description: Roots and grave-moss have grown through what remains of it, anchoring it wherever it was raised.
rootSulDaun.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

mummifiedSulDaun.name: Mummified Sul-Daun
mummifiedSulDaun.description: Desiccated rather than rotted, its wrappings still holding the shape of whatever tomb it was sealed in.
mummifiedSulDaun.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

bloatedSulDaun.name: Bloated Sul-Daun
bloatedSulDaun.description: Swollen with trapped gas and rot, dangerous mainly in how it goes out.
bloatedSulDaun.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

ancientSulDaun.name: Ancient Sul-Daun
ancientSulDaun.description: Old enough that the necromancer who first raised it is long forgotten — it has simply never stopped following orders.
ancientSulDaun.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

armoredSulKeth.name: Armored Sul-Keth
armoredSulKeth.description: Bound to still-standing plate, its bones grinding against metal with every step.
armoredSulKeth.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

ancientSulKeth.name: Ancient Sul-Keth
ancientSulKeth.description: Old enough that its bones have been broken and reassembled more times than can be counted.
ancientSulKeth.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

runicSulKeth.name: Runic Sul-Keth
runicSulKeth.description: Sigils carved into every bone hum faintly, tearing straight through anything raised to guard against it.
runicSulKeth.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

boneSovereign.name: Bone Sovereign
boneSovereign.description: Commands entire fields of the dead by will alone, needing no necromancer of its own anymore.
boneSovereign.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

newSulRau.name: New Sul-Rau
newSulRau.description: A recently-turned revenant, still carrying the shape of a grudge it hasn't finished settling.
newSulRau.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

sulRau.name: Sul-Rau
sulRau.description: Vengeance made animate — it hunts wherever its quarry can be found, and does not stop for terrain.
sulRau.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

rampagingSulRau.name: Rampaging Sul-Rau
rampagingSulRau.description: Long past any single grudge, it now hunts anything living at all.
rampagingSulRau.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

lesserVoranDaun.name: Lesser Voran-Daun
lesserVoranDaun.description: Two bodies stitched into one, still learning how to move as a single thing.
lesserVoranDaun.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

grandVoranDaun.name: Grand Voran-Daun
grandVoranDaun.description: Four hearts, four species, one purpose — a cathedral-sized abomination that refuses to stay dead.
grandVoranDaun.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

mauvenSulei.name: Mauven-Sulei
mauvenSulei.description: A complete manifestation, hands forever over its face, haunting a hidden anchor no one has found.
mauvenSulei.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

tormentedMauvenSulei.name: Tormented Mauven-Sulei
tormentedMauvenSulei.description: Its anchor body is unknown even to itself — pure, perfect torment with nothing left to remember.
tormentedMauvenSulei.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

mourningSpirit.name: Mourning Spirit
mourningSpirit.description: A faint, sobbing shape drifting between headstones, more sorrowful than dangerous — alone.
mourningSpirit.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

restlessDead.name: Restless Dead
restlessDead.description: Denied rest even in the deepest catacombs, it drags an unnatural chill wherever it lingers.
restlessDead.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

orvuinBoss.name: Orvuin
orvuinBoss.description: A calcified stone holding the compressed dead of an entire battlefield, commanding lesser spirits by sheer weight of grief.
orvuinBoss.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

ancientOrvuin.name: Ancient Orvuin
ancientOrvuin.description: The oldest known Orvuin, its grief so vast that entire forgotten kingdoms are named for it.
ancientOrvuin.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

homunculus.name: Homunculus
homunculus.description: A small clay-and-resin construct, cheap to make and cheaper to lose — laboratories keep dozens on hand.
homunculus.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

runicServitor.name: Runic Servitor
runicServitor.description: Bronze and ironwood plating over a stable runic matrix, built to hold a line rather than chase anything.
runicServitor.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

arcaneAutomaton.name: Arcane Automaton
arcaneAutomaton.description: Forged-iron war construct salvaged from an ancient fortress, its core still humming after centuries of silence.
arcaneAutomaton.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

runeSentinel.name: Rune Sentinel
runeSentinel.description: A monumental guardian of granite and runic steel, still standing sentry over vaults nobody remembers the reason for.
runeSentinel.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

primeConstruct.name: Prime Construct
primeConstruct.description: Forged from a divine alloy no living smith can name, standing watch over a citadel whose builders left no other trace.
primeConstruct.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

lesserThuelnMaur.name: Lesser Thueln-Maur
lesserThuelnMaur.description: Packed clay and earth given rough humanoid shape, common wherever a workshop needs cheap muscle.
lesserThuelnMaur.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

timberThuelnMaur.name: Timber Thueln-Maur
timberThuelnMaur.description: Living ironwood shaped into a guardian, rooted deep enough into an ancient grove that it may never have been moved.
timberThuelnMaur.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

crystalThuelnMaur.name: Crystal Thueln-Maur
crystalThuelnMaur.description: Enchanted crystal grown into a humanoid frame, humming faintly with stored arcane charge.
crystalThuelnMaur.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

elderThuelnMaur.name: Elder Thueln-Maur
elderThuelnMaur.description: Divine stone, living ironwood, and crystal fused into a single harmonized guardian — the rarest of its kind by far.
elderThuelnMaur.combatNotes: From the Fragmenta Master Enemy Codex.

tribal_initiate.name: Tribal Initiate
tribal_initiate.description: An entry-level tribal fighter — predictable opening, basic defense. Independent tribal groups aren't inherently hostile; whether this one is depends on the encounter.
tribal_initiate.combatNotes: From the Independent Armed Groups Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

desert_tribal_fighter.name: Desert Tribal Fighter
desert_tribal_fighter.description: A prepared opening followed by a guard cycle — fights a round ahead of where it actually stands.
desert_tribal_fighter.combatNotes: From the Independent Armed Groups Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

caravan_sellsword.name: Caravan Sellsword
caravan_sellsword.native: Caravan roads and private contracts, Sahrimor
caravan_sellsword.description: Consistent contracted offense, backed by a disarming follow-up that leaves a target's own Attack suppressed.
caravan_sellsword.combatNotes: From the Independent Armed Groups Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

tribal_hunter.name: Tribal Hunter
tribal_hunter.description: Accurate burst damage against targets already weakened — an opening strike that only gets better once something's hurt.
tribal_hunter.combatNotes: From the Independent Armed Groups Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

veteran_caravan_escort.name: Veteran Caravan Escort
veteran_caravan_escort.native: Merchant trails and escorted caravans, Sahrimor
veteran_caravan_escort.description: Protects a charge and cycles its own defenses — durable, and sturdier still once it's taken a real hit.
veteran_caravan_escort.combatNotes: From the Independent Armed Groups Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

mercenary_veteran.name: Mercenary Veteran
mercenary_veteran.description: Veteran pressure backed by suppression — a disarming follow-up and a guard cycle, the same toolkit a Caravan Sellsword carries, hardened by experience.
mercenary_veteran.combatNotes: From the Independent Armed Groups Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

tribal_warleader.name: Tribal Warleader
tribal_warleader.native: Tribal strongholds and organized groups, Sahrimor
tribal_warleader.description: Commands a tribal stronghold — rallying its allies' Accuracy, shielding one from harm, and pressing its own advantage once another human ally still stands.
tribal_warleader.combatNotes: From the Independent Armed Groups Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

mercenary_commander.name: Mercenary Commander
mercenary_commander.description: Adaptive leadership backed by focused attacks — a commander who answers whatever's actually happening in the fight, not a fixed script.
mercenary_commander.combatNotes: From the Independent Armed Groups Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

junior_merchant_guard.name: Junior Merchant Guard
junior_merchant_guard.description: An entry-level defender — simple personal mitigation, nothing more. Time your attacks around its guard duration.
junior_merchant_guard.combatNotes: From the Security and Enforcement Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

caravan_guard.name: Caravan Guard
caravan_guard.description: Balanced offense and guard cycling — exploit the intervals when it isn't guarding.
caravan_guard.combatNotes: From the Security and Enforcement Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

city_watchman.name: City Watchman
city_watchman.description: One explicit counter per round, backed by a disarming follow-up. Use careful attack selection and end its guard before pressing.
city_watchman.combatNotes: From the Security and Enforcement Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

veteran_merchant_guard.name: Veteran Merchant Guard
veteran_merchant_guard.description: Sustained mitigation paired with a Defense-weakening follow-up. Exploit the moments it isn't guarded.
veteran_merchant_guard.combatNotes: From the Security and Enforcement Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

caravan_warden.name: Caravan Warden
caravan_warden.description: Targeted ally protection paired with accuracy suppression. Remove the Warden, or switch targets to dodge its protection.
caravan_warden.combatNotes: From the Security and Enforcement Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

merchant_lord_enforcer.name: Merchant Lord Enforcer
merchant_lord_enforcer.description: Attack, Defense, and Accuracy pressure all at once. Cleanse its debuffs, or simply defeat it before they stack.
merchant_lord_enforcer.combatNotes: From the Security and Enforcement Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

merchant_lord_guard_captain.name: Merchant Lord Guard Captain
merchant_lord_guard_captain.description: Defensive group command, backed by one guard arriving mid-fight. Defeat the captain, or thin its reinforcement first.
merchant_lord_guard_captain.combatNotes: From the Security and Enforcement Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

merchant_lord_shieldmaster.name: Merchant Lord Shieldmaster
merchant_lord_shieldmaster.description: Rotating group protection and counterattacks. Time a burst for its uncapped windows.
merchant_lord_shieldmaster.combatNotes: From the Security and Enforcement Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

fedahl_recruit.name: Fedahl Recruit
fedahl_recruit.description: Simple armed pressure from an early military fighter.
fedahl_recruit.combatNotes: From the Sahrimor Military Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

bahrun_sailor.name: Bahrun Sailor
bahrun_sailor.native: Sahrimor ports and armed merchant vessels
bahrun_sailor.description: A naval aggressor — offense backed by weapon suppression. Exploit the Defense penalty once it lands.
bahrun_sailor.combatNotes: From the Sahrimor Military Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

farahl_scout.name: Farahl Scout
farahl_scout.description: Fast cavalry scouting — an opening burst, then a Speed surge to match. Mitigate the opener and capitalize on its exposure after.
farahl_scout.combatNotes: From the Sahrimor Military Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

ramahsi_bowman.name: Ramahsi Bowman
ramahsi_bowman.native: Sahrimor desert patrols and archery posts
ramahsi_bowman.description: Reliable ranged precision. Reduce its Accuracy, or defeat the archer outright.
ramahsi_bowman.combatNotes: From the Sahrimor Military Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

khandari_infantryman.name: Khandari Infantryman
khandari_infantryman.description: A guard cycle backed by a bounded counter. Avoid repeated counter exposure.
khandari_infantryman.combatNotes: From the Sahrimor Military Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

veteran_fedahl.name: Veteran Fedahl
veteran_fedahl.description: A reliable balance of Attack and Defense. Overcome its disciplined guard cycle to press an advantage.
veteran_fedahl.combatNotes: From the Sahrimor Military Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

farahl_veteran.name: Farahl Veteran
farahl_veteran.description: Advanced offensive cadence. Anticipate the opening and punish its recovery.
farahl_veteran.combatNotes: From the Sahrimor Military Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

ramahsi_sharpshooter.name: Ramahsi Sharpshooter
ramahsi_sharpshooter.description: An accurate volley with real suppression behind it. Prioritize this ranged threat first.
ramahsi_sharpshooter.combatNotes: From the Sahrimor Military Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

khandari_veteran.name: Khandari Veteran
khandari_veteran.description: Survivability paired with counter-pressure. Exploit its guard timing, and cleanse whatever debuffs it lands.
khandari_veteran.combatNotes: From the Sahrimor Military Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

naqari_section_leader.name: Naqari Section Leader
naqari_section_leader.description: A limited accuracy rally, paired with an allied attack. Target the section leader first.
naqari_section_leader.combatNotes: From the Sahrimor Military Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

filhari_war_rider.name: Filhari War Rider
filhari_war_rider.description: High-impact attacks with real cooldown vulnerability afterward. Defend the heavy strike and exploit its recovery.
filhari_war_rider.combatNotes: From the Sahrimor Military Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8). Rider and mount are one combat entity — no separate mount Health pool or positional movement.

akharul_sakharul.name: Akharul Sakharul
akharul_sakharul.description: Scorpion Lunge brings venom and a self-penalty alike. Cleanse Venomed, and exploit the reduced Accuracy that follows.
akharul_sakharul.combatNotes: From the Sahrimor Military Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8). Rider and mount are one combat entity — no separate mount Health pool or positional movement.

qahir_unit_commander.name: Qahir Unit Commander
qahir_unit_commander.description: Accuracy support, coordinated attacks, and defensive orders all at once. Break the command chain.
qahir_unit_commander.combatNotes: From the Sahrimor Military Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

amahri_field_commander.name: Amahri Field Commander
amahri_field_commander.description: Changes its coordinated orders by Health. Adapt to the order given, or defeat its supporting troops first.
amahri_field_commander.combatNotes: From the Sahrimor Military Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

sardarr_army_commander.name: Sardarr Army Commander
sardarr_army_commander.description: Offensive command backed by a last stand. Reduce its entourage, and respond to its command timing.
sardarr_army_commander.combatNotes: From the Sahrimor Military Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

street_ruffian.name: Street Ruffian
street_ruffian.description: Simple close-quarters pressure. Basic mitigation and sustained attacks are enough to see it off.
street_ruffian.combatNotes: From the Criminal Underworld Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

petty_cutpurse.name: Petty Cutpurse
petty_cutpurse.description: Opening burst against vulnerable targets. Survive the opener, and it has little else to offer.
petty_cutpurse.combatNotes: From the Criminal Underworld Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

roadside_bandit.name: Roadside Bandit
roadside_bandit.description: Committed damage, but recovery leaves it exposed. Counterattack during its exposed turns.
roadside_bandit.combatNotes: From the Criminal Underworld Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

bandit_lookout.name: Bandit Lookout
bandit_lookout.description: Improves allied hit reliability from a distance. Eliminate it before its buffed attackers close in.
bandit_lookout.combatNotes: From the Criminal Underworld Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

bandit_cutthroat.name: Bandit Cutthroat
bandit_cutthroat.description: Target-focused opening and finishing damage. Protect vulnerable targets, and capitalize on its own low Defense.
bandit_cutthroat.combatNotes: From the Criminal Underworld Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

bandit_enforcer.name: Bandit Enforcer
bandit_enforcer.description: Durability paired with Defense weakening. Exploit its overcommitment and suppress its offense.
bandit_enforcer.combatNotes: From the Criminal Underworld Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

smuggler_veteran.name: Smuggler Veteran
smuggler_veteran.description: Changes between defense, precision, and suppression. Respond to its stance, and avoid prolonged suppression.
smuggler_veteran.combatNotes: From the Criminal Underworld Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

bandit_captain.name: Bandit Captain
bandit_captain.description: Accuracy support, backed by one arriving Cutthroat. Eliminate the captain, or the weakened reinforcement first.
bandit_captain.combatNotes: From the Criminal Underworld Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

bandit_warlord.name: Bandit Warlord
bandit_warlord.description: Escalating group Attack and personal aggression. Reduce its entourage, and exploit the Defense penalty it leaves itself.
bandit_warlord.combatNotes: From the Criminal Underworld Equipment Codex (Gate 5B.8).

street_thug.name: Street Thug
street_thug.native: Sanguivorum back alleys and city streets
street_thug.description: A plain street brawler with one hard-hitting club swing — nothing subtle, nothing held back.
street_thug.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Criminal Underworld Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

market_cutpurse.name: Market Cutpurse
market_cutpurse.description: Fast and opportunistic — strikes hardest the moment a fight opens, then keeps stabbing.
market_cutpurse.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Criminal Underworld Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

imperial_road_bandit.name: Imperial Road Bandit
imperial_road_bandit.description: A committed highway skirmisher, backed by a Speed-suppressing shield bash.
imperial_road_bandit.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Criminal Underworld Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

roadside_lookout.name: Roadside Lookout
roadside_lookout.description: A spotter who rallies its allies' aim and marks a target for them before taking its own shot.
roadside_lookout.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Criminal Underworld Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

highway_cutthroat.name: Highway Cutthroat
highway_cutthroat.description: A bladed ambusher that opens with a crit-heavy first strike, then bleeds a target out.
highway_cutthroat.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Criminal Underworld Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B). Three equipment bands (V1/V2/V3), one shared base identity.

caravan_ambusher.name: Caravan Ambusher
caravan_ambusher.description: An opening-burst brawler — hits hardest the moment it swings first, and again on a reckless follow-up.
caravan_ambusher.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Criminal Underworld Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

border_smuggler.name: Border Smuggler
border_smuggler.description: A defensive specialist who opens guarded and answers pressure with a disarming counter-riposte.
border_smuggler.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Criminal Underworld Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

disgraced_ovum_fighter.name: Disgraced Ovum Fighter
disgraced_ovum_fighter.native: Sanguivorum arena circuits, fallen from grace
disgraced_ovum_fighter.description: A disgraced arena duelist, twin blades still sharp — fights hardest once it's bleeding.
disgraced_ovum_fighter.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Criminal Underworld Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

outlaw_packmaster.name: Outlaw Packmaster
outlaw_packmaster.description: Calls outlaw hounds to its side and fights steadier for every one still standing.
outlaw_packmaster.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Criminal Underworld Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

highway_captain.name: Highway Captain
highway_captain.description: A tactical highway commander — rallies its crew's aim, guards itself when hurt, and presses any opening.
highway_captain.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Criminal Underworld Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

roadlord.name: Roadlord
roadlord.description: An aggressive warlord of the highways — ruthless with the wounded, and more dangerous with every kill.
roadlord.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Criminal Underworld Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

legion_recruit.name: Legion Recruit
legion_recruit.description: A green legion recruit, drilled on the basics and little else.
legion_recruit.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Imperial Military Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

ferratum_infantryman.name: Ferratum Infantryman
ferratum_infantryman.description: A disciplined line infantryman, shield braced and spear levelled.
ferratum_infantryman.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Imperial Military Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

ferratum_veteran.name: Ferratum Veteran
ferratum_veteran.description: A hardened veteran of the Ferratum line — steadier than any recruit, and fights harder once wounded.
ferratum_veteran.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Imperial Military Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B). Three equipment bands (V1/V2/V3), one shared base identity.

ingenum_field_engineer.name: Ingenum Field Engineer
ingenum_field_engineer.description: A legion engineer, crossbow calibrated and a sabotaging bolt ready for an exposed flank.
ingenum_field_engineer.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Imperial Military Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

ingenum_ballistarius.name: Ingenum Ballistarius
ingenum_ballistarius.description: A hand-crankbow specialist who prepares its shot before loosing a discharge no ordinary soldier can match.
ingenum_ballistarius.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Imperial Military Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B). The siege ballista itself is intrinsic encounter presentation, not lootable equipment — this is the hand-usable precision crankbow.

agilum_scout.name: Agilum Scout
agilum_scout.description: A fast reconnaissance scout, quickest off the mark and gone again before a reply lands.
agilum_scout.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Imperial Military Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

impetum_war_rider.name: Impetum War Rider
impetum_war_rider.description: A mounted shock rider, lance levelled for one devastating opening charge.
impetum_war_rider.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Imperial Military Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

aqualis_sailor.name: Aqualis Sailor
aqualis_sailor.description: A naval deckhand, cutlass and boarding hook both close at hand.
aqualis_sailor.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Imperial Military Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

aqualis_marine.name: Aqualis Marine
aqualis_marine.description: A boarding-trained marine, steadier still with another Aqualis unit at its side.
aqualis_marine.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Imperial Military Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B). Two equipment bands (V1/V2), one shared base identity.

gradus_veteran.name: Gradus Veteran
gradus_veteran.description: A seasoned legion veteran who steadies the line for whoever's fighting beside it.
gradus_veteran.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Imperial Military Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B). Three equipment bands (V1/V2/V3), one shared base identity.

ductus_section_commander.name: Ductus Section Commander
ductus_section_commander.description: A section commander, surer-eyed for every Imperial Military ally still standing beside it.
ductus_section_commander.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Imperial Military Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B). Two equipment bands (V1/V2), one shared base identity.

vigilis_unit_commander.name: Vigilis Unit Commander
vigilis_unit_commander.description: A unit commander who only fights harder for a wound, and steadier for every ally still in the line.
vigilis_unit_commander.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Imperial Military Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

arbitarius_commander.name: Arbitarius Commander
arbitarius_commander.description: The highest Imperial Military authority on the field, coordinating every specialization under its command and most dangerous when badly hurt.
arbitarius_commander.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Imperial Military Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

legion_houndmaster.name: Legion Houndmaster
legion_houndmaster.native: Sanguivorum legion garrisons, military animal support
legion_houndmaster.description: A legion kennelmaster, already flanked by one trained Legion Hound before the fight even starts.
legion_houndmaster.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Imperial Military Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B).

legion_hound.name: Legion Hound
legion_hound.native: Sanguivorum legion garrisons, military animal support
legion_hound.description: A trained legion war-hound, loosed at its handler's whistle.
legion_hound.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Imperial Military Division Codex (v0.3, Step 4.A/4.B) — summon target for Prepared Warhound/Deploy Legion Hounds; no separate owner-provided stat block, sized against this codex's own low-tier identities.

junior_city_watchman.name: Junior City Watchman
junior_city_watchman.description: A green city watchman, still more comfortable braced behind a shield than throwing the first blow.
junior_city_watchman.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Security and Enforcement Division Codex (v0.1, Step4AB).

market_watchman.name: Market Watchman
market_watchman.description: A crowd-control specialist who batons down an unruly stall-side dispute before it spreads.
market_watchman.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Security and Enforcement Division Codex (v0.1, Step4AB).

road_warden.name: Road Warden
road_warden.description: A steady road patroller, shield braced and ledger in hand for whatever the route brings.
road_warden.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Security and Enforcement Division Codex (v0.1, Step4AB).

harbor_watchman.name: Harbor Watchman
harbor_watchman.description: A dockside enforcer, boarding hook ready to drag a fleeing smuggler back onto the pier.
harbor_watchman.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Security and Enforcement Division Codex (v0.1, Step4AB).

veteran_city_guard.name: Veteran City Guard
veteran_city_guard.description: A hardened watch veteran, steadier behind a raised shield and quick to punish anyone who presses in while it's up.
veteran_city_guard.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Security and Enforcement Division Codex (v0.1, Step4AB). Three equipment bands (V1/V2/V3), one shared base identity.

frontier_gatekeeper.name: Frontier Gatekeeper
frontier_gatekeeper.description: A checkpoint tank, spear levelled and tower shield braced across the one road anyone's getting through.
frontier_gatekeeper.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Security and Enforcement Division Codex (v0.1, Step4AB).

imperial_investigator.name: Imperial Investigator
imperial_investigator.description: A precision interrogator who reads a stance for its weak point before ever drawing a blade.
imperial_investigator.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Security and Enforcement Division Codex (v0.1, Step4AB).

watch_captain.name: Watch Captain
watch_captain.description: A defensive leader who steadies every watch guard still standing beside it, and only hits harder once it's hurt.
watch_captain.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Security and Enforcement Division Codex (v0.1, Step4AB). Base HP uses the codex's own itemized Captain's Enforcement Armor total (+8 HP); the codex's separate narrative '+11 HP' claim for this same chest piece doesn't reconcile with its own itemized breakdown and was NOT used — see Appendix B of the codex and this division's implementation report.

ovum_veteran_guard.name: Ovum Veteran Guard
ovum_veteran_guard.description: An arena-seasoned defensive duelist, shield raised and ready to answer any hit that actually lands.
ovum_veteran_guard.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Security and Enforcement Division Codex (v0.1, Step4AB). Preserved as the approved arena-derived protective specialist (codex Section 02).

militia_volunteer.name: Militia Volunteer
militia_volunteer.description: A village militia volunteer, spear in hand and ready to call for help the moment things go wrong.
militia_volunteer.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Independent Armed Groups Division Codex (Step 4.A/4.B).

rural_militia_fighter.name: Rural Militia Fighter
rural_militia_fighter.description: A rough-handed militia fighter, axe already swinging and a crowd of locals ready to answer its call.
rural_militia_fighter.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Independent Armed Groups Division Codex (Step 4.A/4.B). Two equipment bands (V1/V2), one shared base identity.

independent_scout.name: Independent Scout
independent_scout.description: A quick-footed independent scout, bow drawn and gone again before a reply lands.
independent_scout.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Independent Armed Groups Division Codex (Step 4.A/4.B). Base DEF uses the codex's own itemized equipment total (+5 DEF), per the owner's standing decision to trust itemized totals over the codex's separate narrative +3 DEF claim (Step-5 cross-division audit).

road_convoy_guard.name: Road Convoy Guard
road_convoy_guard.description: A paid-for convoy guard, shield braced and contract terms clear: nothing gets through while it's standing.
road_convoy_guard.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Independent Armed Groups Division Codex (Step 4.A/4.B). Three equipment bands (V1/V2/V3), one shared base identity.

contract_marksman.name: Contract Marksman
contract_marksman.description: A hired crossbow specialist, patient until the aim is true and the bolt can't miss.
contract_marksman.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Independent Armed Groups Division Codex (Step 4.A/4.B).

free_company_captain.name: Free Company Captain
free_company_captain.description: A tactical mercenary leader, standard raised and a full company of professionals ready on its call.
free_company_captain.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Independent Armed Groups Division Codex (Step 4.A/4.B).

ovum_prizefighter.name: Ovum Prizefighter
ovum_prizefighter.description: A technical arena duelist, trident and net worked together to turn a stumble into an opening.
ovum_prizefighter.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Independent Armed Groups Division Codex (Step 4.A/4.B).

ovum_champion.name: Ovum Champion
ovum_champion.description: The arena's own master duelist, patient behind a raised guard until the one exchange that ends it.
ovum_champion.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Independent Armed Groups Division Codex (Step 4.A/4.B). Base HP already includes the codex's own itemized Ovum Champion Cuirass (+8 HP) and Ovum Championship Medal (+5 HP).

contract_blade.name: Contract Blade
contract_blade.description: A hired blade, concealed dagger ready and an opening ambush it never wastes.
contract_blade.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Independent Armed Groups Division Codex (Step 4.A/4.B). Ambush reuses the existing ambush_bonus id byte-for-byte, per the codex's own 'existing pattern' description.

veiled_executor.name: Veiled Executor
veiled_executor.description: A veiled contract executor, poisoned edge patient and precise once the opening finally comes.
veiled_executor.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Independent Armed Groups Division Codex (Step 4.A/4.B). Poisoned Edge inflicts the new sang_iag_poison status (data/enemyabilities.js).

arena_beastmaster.name: Arena Beastmaster
arena_beastmaster.description: An arena beastmaster, whistle at the ready to release whatever the pit still has caged.
arena_beastmaster.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Independent Armed Groups Division Codex (Step 4.A/4.B). Release the Beasts draws from the same timberWolf/duskWolf pool Criminal Underworld's own Call Outlaw Hounds already uses; Handler's Spear reuses the existing handlers_spear id verbatim (Sanguivorum Imperial Military).

militia_warleader.name: Militia Warleader
militia_warleader.description: The militia's own aggressive warleader, cleaving a path forward and daring the fight to drag on long enough to raise the whole muster.
militia_warleader.combatNotes: From the Sanguivorum Independent Armed Groups Division Codex (Step 4.A/4.B). Base HP already includes the codex's own itemized Reinforced Militia War Armor (+5 HP).

human.name: Human
human.tagline: No trick up the sleeve — steady, adaptable, at home anywhere.

dragonkin.name: DragonKin
dragonkin.tagline: Part of the old triarchy blood — hot-tempered, hard-scaled, half a step from the old fire.

lizardfolk.name: Lizardfolk
lizardfolk.tagline: Swamp-born strength — slow to think it through, impossible to put down.

elf.name: Elf
elf.tagline: Precise, patient, and long past being impressed by anything that isn't.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.tagline: Built low, built heavy, built to still be standing when everything else has stopped.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.tagline: Hits hardest, stands longest — a straightforward answer to most problems.

scout.name: Scout
scout.tagline: Fast, precise, and gone before the fight settles into a fair one.

apothecary.name: Apothecary
apothecary.tagline: Keeps a party standing and knows more than it hits for.

mage.name: Mage
mage.tagline: Tower-trained, registered, and drawing on a discipline most people never touch.

bruise.name: Bruise
bruise.tagline: Self-taught, unregistered, and always ready to be somewhere else in a hurry.

human_legionary.name: Sanguivorum Legionary
human_legionary.tagline: A soldier of the Empire of the Meadows, off the leash for the first time in years.
human_legionary.intro: Twelve years drilled into the same maxim as every other Legionary: a citizen is a tool that knows itself. You know exactly what tool you are. Lately you've started wondering if that's a problem.

human_mercenary.name: Sahrimor Mercenary
human_mercenary.tagline: A hired blade out of the Mugamiir Safor, between contracts.
inventory: a contract chit from the Mugamiir Safor
human_mercenary.intro: You've made a living the Sahrimori way: for the right price, through the right guild. The Mugamiir Safor took its cut and pointed you at whatever paid. This time you're between contracts, and your coin purse is doing the talking.

human_ashfeld_settler.name: Thraekor Ashfeld Settler
human_ashfeld_settler.tagline: One of the few humans the Ash Confederation let put down roots.
inventory: a letter of introduction to the Stillwarden's court
human_ashfeld_settler.intro: You came to Khar-Athel as a trader's apprentice and never quite left. Thraekor doesn't naturalize outsiders easily, but endurance is the one virtue it actually respects, and you had enough of it to be let stay.

dragonkin_triarchy_voice.name: Vaeloris Triarchy Voice
dragonkin_triarchy_voice.tagline: A seated voice in the Arbor's triarchy of elves, lizardfolk, and dragonborn.
inventory: a woven cloak in Vaeloris green
a small carved figure of Sylvorn Vaelithar
dragonkin_triarchy_voice.intro: You grew up in the Arbor's upper branches, one of the DragonKin voices Sylvorn Vaelithar's triarchy is built on. The Witnessed have watched you your whole life. You've started to feel watched back.

dragonkin_emberkin.name: Thraekor Emberkin
dragonkin_emberkin.tagline: A DragonKin who found Thraekor's ash and fire more like home than the Arbor's canopy.
dragonkin_emberkin.intro: Khar-Athel's volcano never bothered you the way it bothers most visitors — if anything, the heat felt like something you recognized. The Stillwarden's clan took that as a sign worth trusting.

dragonkin_wanderer.name: Sanguivorum Wanderer
dragonkin_wanderer.tagline: A DragonKin who did a stint in the Empire's Legions and kept walking after.
dragonkin_wanderer.intro: The Legion took you the way it takes anyone useful, DragonKin or not, and taught you its maxims along with everyone else. You served your term, took your discharge, and never quite stopped moving.

lizardfolk_hegemony.name: Swamp Hegemony Enclave
lizardfolk_hegemony.tagline: Born in Drath Vorrumbruk, the deep swamp heart of the Lizardfolk-held Hegemony.
inventory: a jar of preserved swamp herbs
lizardfolk_hegemony.intro: Drath Vorrumbruk doesn't show itself to outsiders — you never needed it to. You grew up in the true swamp heart of the Hegemony, where Druith the Ancient still sleeps and the Great Lizard is said to speak in a tongue older than any nation's, guiding it the way every Lizardfolk child eventually learns to.

lizardfolk_triarchy.name: Arbor Triarchy
lizardfolk_triarchy.tagline: A seated voice in the Arbor's triarchy, same standing as its elves and dragonborn.
inventory: a woven cloak in Vaeloris green
lizardfolk_triarchy.intro: You hold a seat in the same triarchy the elves and dragonborn do, under Sylvorn Vaelithar's rule from the Arbor's branches. Fewer of your own kind visit the canopy than the swamp, but the standing is real.

lizardfolk_diaspora.name: Sahrimor Desert Diaspora
lizardfolk_diaspora.tagline: Swamp-born, desert-hardened — one of the few Lizardfolk the Mugamiir Safor bothers to hire.
inventory: a contract chit from the Mugamiir Safor
lizardfolk_diaspora.intro: You left the swamp for the desert on a bet with yourself, and the Mugamiir Safor turned out to pay better than anything back home. Sahurim's heat is nothing next to the Hegemony's damp.

elf_thornwatch.name: Vaeloris Thornwatch
elf_thornwatch.tagline: A forest ranger of the Rooted Legion, more at home in the canopy than the court.
elf_thornwatch.intro: You've spent more nights under the Arbor's canopy than under any roof. The Thornwatch trained you to move where the forest doesn't want to be moved through, and to notice things the oracles never bother looking down to see.

elf_scholar.name: Sanguivorum Scholar
elf_scholar.tagline: An elf who traded the Arbor's canopy for the Empire's archives.
inventory: a letter of introduction to Arethon's registry
elf_scholar.intro: The Empire's archives don't care much what species catalogs them, and you found you had a talent for it the Arbor never gave you much use for. Arethon's registry has been your whole world for years now.

elf_wanderer.name: Sahrimor Wanderer
elf_wanderer.tagline: An elf who took the Mugamiir Safor's coin and never went back to the canopy.
inventory: a contract chit from the Mugamiir Safor
elf_wanderer.intro: Sahurim's caravan roads suited you better than the Arbor's stillness ever did. The Mugamiir Safor doesn't ask where a contractor is from, only whether the work gets done.

dwarf_clanwarrior.name: Thraekor Clan Warrior
dwarf_clanwarrior.tagline: A dwarf of the Ash Confederation, raised on the principle that endurance is the only virtue that counts.
dwarf_clanwarrior.intro: What remains after everything burns — you were raised on the Ash Principle the way other children are raised on lullabies. Thraekor doesn't produce many people who flinch. You were never given the option to be one of them.

dwarf_emigrant.name: Sanguivorum Emigrant
dwarf_emigrant.tagline: A dwarf who left Thraekor's ash for the Empire's roads and never looked back.
dwarf_emigrant.intro: Thraekor's Ash Principle never sat right with you — you wanted something that lasted for a reason, not just out of stubbornness. The Empire's roads offered steadier ground, and you took it.

dwarf_guildwright.name: Sahrimor Guildwright
dwarf_guildwright.tagline: A dwarf who put Thraekor's craftsmanship to work for the Mugamiir Safor instead.
inventory: a contract chit from the Mugamiir Safor
dwarf_guildwright.intro: You learned your trade in Thraekor's forges, then sold it to whoever the Mugamiir Safor pointed you at. Sahurim's guilds pay better for good work than Khar-Athel ever did.

kabal_recruit.name: Kabal Recruit
kabal_recruit.tagline: A mage-in-training, registered, tithed, and watched — Class is set to Mage.

introByRace.human: You are registered, tithed, and still years from a real Path. The Kabal Tower has been the whole of your world since you were found to have an affinity for a river you can't yet properly touch.
introByRace.dragonkin: The Kabal doesn't much care that your blood runs hotter than a human novitiate's — an affinity is an affinity. You are registered, tithed, and still years from a real Path, same as everyone else in the Tower.
introByRace.lizardfolk: Few of your kind ever leave the swamp for the Tower, which made the Kabal's interest in you feel less like an honor and more like a specimen jar. You are registered and tithed regardless.
introByRace.elf: You'd expected the Arbor's oracles to notice your affinity before the Kabal ever did. They didn't. The Tower did, and now you are registered, tithed, and still years from a real Path.
introByRace.dwarf: Thraekor doesn't send many of its own to the Kabal Tower, and the ones who go rarely come back. You are registered, tithed, and trying not to think about which one you'll turn out to be.

norrvael_fled.name: Fled to Norrvael
norrvael_fled.tagline: An unregistered mage, hunted on sight, gone to ground on the Isle of Silence and Drakes — Class is set to Bruise.
inventory: half a loaf of stale bread

introByRace.human: The Kabal has a word for what you are: Bruise. Unregistered, untithed, unsanctioned — killable on sight by anyone who can prove it. You ran until you ran out of mainland to run on, and Norrvael's mist took you in without asking questions.
introByRace.dragonkin: The Kabal has a word for what you are: Bruise, same as any unregistered mage, DragonKin blood or not. You ran until you ran out of mainland, and Norrvael's mist — and its own dragons — took you in without asking questions.
introByRace.lizardfolk: The Kabal has a word for what you are: Bruise. Unregistered, untithed, unsanctioned. The swamp couldn't hide you from a Tower that wanted to look hard enough, so you crossed the water instead, to Norrvael's mist.
introByRace.elf: The Kabal has a word for what you are: Bruise. The Arbor's oracles could have vouched for you and didn't. You ran until you ran out of mainland to run on, and Norrvael's mist took you in without asking questions.
introByRace.dwarf: The Kabal has a word for what you are: Bruise. Thraekor's clans don't shelter unregistered mages any better than anyone else does. You ran until you ran out of mainland to run on, and Norrvael's mist took you in without asking questions.

value.name: Hadrian Voric
value.title: The Champion
value.tagline: the Grand Ovum's reigning Champion, undefeated in eleven years of bouts
value.description: Tall and olive-toned, deeply tanned from years spent under Sahrimor's sun, with dark hair going grey and a face notably unscarred — young fighters often doubt he's the real Champion until he proves them wrong. Studded leather underarmor in the Red Creed's colors, polished plate over the arms and shoulders stamped with Kar'Mhal's horned-helm-and-burning-sword, and a two-handed maul wielded with the crushing, unhurried confidence of someone who has never needed to hurry. A sash — once white silk, now soaked entirely crimson by years of victories, never washed — is clipped at his left shoulder and drapes to the hip.
value.narrative: An unknown pit fighter once, before the Sanguivorum-Sahrimor war put him in the Legion as Ferratum heavy infantry. He rose to Vigilis and retired after single-handedly defeating the Akharu general Astra Sa'Lahru, taking a near-fatal wound to the chest that left him permanently vulnerable to poison, toxins, and decay.
